jobs.title: Senior Wealth Planner - Zurich
jobs.description:
You will join the Wealth Planning Team at Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) in Zurich, Switzerland.
 In this role, you will serve clients and partner with Relationship Managers to ensure that wealth planning needs are appropriately addressed.
 You will provide guidance on succession and legacy planning, tax suitability, mobility planning, and wealth structuring—based on each client’s specific circumstances—to create added value and mitigate risk, collaborating with Compliance on an on-demand basis to ensure alignment with KYC/AML requirements and internal policies.
 The role also includes delivering training and presentations on compliant wealth planning strategies and options, helping clients stay ahead of fast-changing, increasingly complex regulations and protect their wealth while maximizing after-tax income, and preparing timely, accurate internal Wealth Planning Alerts and client memorandums on the topics outlined above.

Main responsibilities:

• Proactive engagement with bankers to recognize and anticipate clients’ needs, and to identify, and capture business opportunities.

• Provide and train Private Bankers with up-to-date, relevant technical information to understand impactful tax and legal developments and take proper action.

• Identify, present and discuss appropriate and compliant wealth planning solutions and strategies to meet clients’ needs: deliver customized service and bespoke strategies.

• Meet clients and prospects (including business travel with bankers)

• Actively promote Wealth Planning services across the Bank via ad hoc presentations and publications on selected, high-impact themes; actively support tax and legal wealth-preservation objectives.

• Maintain a high level of technical expertise on dedicated markets and take an effective, risk-based and outcomes-focused approach to mitigate risks.

• Build and maintain a network of intermediaries such as trust and corporate service providers, tax and law firms.

• Comply with external and internal compliance and regulatory requirements, including the Bank’s policies, operating procedures and controls to meet the Bank’s and regulatory requirements and protect the business from legal, financial and reputational risk.

• Integrate with the local team of Wealth Planners based in Zurich; collaborate across UBP Group; report to Head of Wealth Planning – Switzerland, based in Geneva.

• Partner with the Compliance Department to review complex existing cases and fiduciary/ownership structures (trusts, foundations, SPVs) strictly on a Compliance-initiated, on-demand basis; verify beneficial ownership and document structuring rationales in line with KYC/AML policies and cross-border rules.

• Support onboarding for structure-heavy clients only upon Compliance request: UBO identification, rationale, required entity documentation, ownership charts, and justification memos to facilitate Compliance approval.

• Perform periodic and event-driven reviews (e.g., KYC refresh, trigger events) exclusively when initiated by Compliance.

Requirements:

• 12+ years of relevant experience in wealth planning services

• Deep expertise in UK and Anglo-Saxon wealth structuring, with a proven track record of success in these jurisdictions.

• Broad, advanced knowledge across core wealth planning disciplines (tax, legal, succession, governance), evidenced by complex case execution and client impac t.

• Law background/diploma required for this role

• Fluency in English; German and additional languages are an advantage

• Confident, persuasive communicator with excellent presentation skills

• Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics for varied audiences

• Resilient and adaptable: able to perform under pressure, prioritize effectively, and maintain high standards

• Self-motivated, service driven, and relentlessly focused on client outcomes

• Strong team player, highly organized with exceptional attention to detail

This is a 100% role located in Zurich.
 Start: asap

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ti unirai al Wealth Planning Team di Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) a Zurigo, Svizzera. In questo ruolo, servirai clienti e partner con Relationship Manager per garantire che le esigenze di pianificazione della ricchezza siano adeguatamente affrontate. Per creare valore aggiunto e mitigare il rischio, collaborando con Compliance su base on-demand per garantire l’allineamento con i requisiti KYC/AML e le politiche interne, l’utente fornirà indicazioni su successione e pianificazione legacy, idoneità fiscale, pianificazione della mobilità e strutturazione della ricchezza. Il ruolo include anche la fornitura di formazione e presentazioni su strategie e opzioni di pianificazione patrimoniale conformi, aiutando i clienti a rimanere in vista di regolamenti in rapida evoluzione e sempre più complessi e proteggere la loro ricchezza, massimizzando il reddito post-tassa, e la preparazione tempestiva, accurata Wealth Planning Alerts e Memoria clienti sui temi sopra descritti. Principali responsabilità:
• Impegno attivo con i banchieri per riconoscere e anticipare le esigenze dei clienti, e per identificare e cogliere opportunità di business.
• Fornire e formare i banchieri privati con informazioni tecniche aggiornate e pertinenti per comprendere gli sviluppi fiscali e legali di impatto e agire correttamente.
• Identificare, presentare e discutere soluzioni e strategie di pianificazione patrimoniale adeguate e conformi per soddisfare le esigenze dei clienti: fornire servizi personalizzati e strategie su misura.
• Incontra clienti e prospettive (tra cui viaggi d'affari con banchieri)
• Promuovere attivamente i servizi di Wealth Planning in tutta la Banca attraverso presentazioni ad hoc e pubblicazioni su temi selezionati e ad alto impatto; sostenere attivamente gli obiettivi fiscali e legali di conservazione della ricchezza.
• Mantenere un elevato livello di competenze tecniche sui mercati dedicati e adottare un approccio efficace, basato sul rischio e focalizzato sui risultati per mitigare i rischi.
• Costruire e mantenere una rete di intermediari quali fiducia e fornitori di servizi aziendali, società fiscali e legali.
• Complessivamente ai requisiti di conformità e regolamentazione esterni e interni, comprese le politiche, le procedure operative e i controlli della Banca per soddisfare i requisiti normativi e regolamentari della Banca e proteggere il business dal rischio legale, finanziario e reputazionale.
• Integrare con il team locale di Wealth Planners con sede a Zurigo; collaborare in tutto il Gruppo UBP; rapporto al responsabile della pianificazione della ricchezza – Svizzera, con sede a Ginevra.
• Collaborare con il Dipartimento Compliance per rivedere complessi casi esistenti e strutture fiduciarie/proprietarie (trust, fondazioni, SPV) rigorosamente su base di Compliance-initiated, on-demand; verificare la proprietà benefica e strutturare i razionali di documentazione in linea con le politiche KYC/AML e le regole transfrontaliere.
• Supporto onboarding per i clienti struttura-pesante solo su richiesta di conformità: identificazione UBO, razionalità, documentazione dell'entità richiesta, grafici di proprietà e memo di giustificazione per facilitare l'approvazione della conformità.
• Eseguire revisioni periodiche ed eventi (ad esempio, aggiornamento KYC, eventi trigger) esclusivamente quando è stato avviato da Compliance. Requisiti:
• 12+ anni di esperienza rilevante nei servizi di pianificazione della ricchezza
• Competenze profonde nel Regno Unito e nella strutturazione della ricchezza anglosassone, con un comprovato record di successo in queste giurisdizioni.
• Conoscenza ampia e avanzata attraverso le principali discipline di pianificazione della ricchezza (tassa, legale, successione, governance), evidenziata da complesse esecuzioni dei casi e impatto del cliente.
• Sfondo accademico in diritto o finanza; una laurea in diritto e/o qualifica come avvocato fiscale è un vantaggio forte
• Fluency in inglese e tedesco; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio
• Confidente, persuasivo comunicatore con eccellenti capacità di presentazione
• Eccezionale capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta, con la capacità di semplificare argomenti complessi per il pubblico vario
• Resiliente e adattabile: in grado di eseguire sotto pressione, priorizzare efficacemente e mantenere elevati standard
• Automotivata, guidata dal servizio e instancabilmente focalizzata sui risultati del cliente
• Giocatore di squadra forte, altamente organizzato con eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli Questo è un ruolo al 100% situato a Zurigo. Inizio: asap

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sie werden Teil des Wealth Planning Teams der Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) in Zürich, Schweiz. In dieser Rolle betreuen Sie Kunden und arbeiten mit Relationship Managern zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass der Bedarf an Vermögensplanung angemessen berücksichtigt wird. Sie unterstützen Sie bei der Nachfolge- und Legacy-Planung, der Steuereignung, der Mobilitätsplanung und der Vermögensstrukturierung - basierend auf den spezifischen Umständen jedes Kunden -, um Mehrwert zu schaffen und Risiken zu mindern, indem Sie auf On-Demand-Basis mit Compliance zusammenarbeiten, um die Übereinstimmung mit den KYC / AML-Anforderungen und internen Richtlinien sicherzustellen. Die Rolle umfasst auch die Bereitstellung von Schulungen und Präsentationen zu konformen Vermögensplanungsstrategien und -optionen, die Kunden dabei unterstützen, den sich schnell verändernden, zunehmend komplexen Vorschriften einen Schritt voraus zu sein und ihr Vermögen zu schützen, während sie das Einkommen nach Steuern maximieren und zeitnahe, genaue interne Wealth Planning Alerts und Kundenmemoranden zu den oben genannten Themen vorbereiten. Hauptzuständigkeiten:
• Proaktives Engagement mit Bankern, um die Bedürfnisse der Kunden zu erkennen und zu antizipieren sowie Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und zu nutzen.
• Bereitstellung und Schulung von Privatbankern mit aktuellen, relevanten technischen Informationen, um wirkungsvolle steuerliche und rechtliche Entwicklungen zu verstehen und angemessene Maßnahmen zu ergreifen.
• Identifizieren, präsentieren und diskutieren Sie geeignete und konforme Vermögensplanungslösungen und -strategien, um die Bedürfnisse der Kunden zu erfüllen: liefern Sie maßgeschneiderte Dienstleistungen und maßgeschneiderte Strategien.
• Kunden und Interessenten treffen (einschließlich Geschäftsreisen mit Bankern)
• Aktive Förderung von Vermögensplanungsdienstleistungen in der gesamten Bank durch Ad-hoc-Präsentationen und Veröffentlichungen zu ausgewählten, einflussreichen Themen; aktive Unterstützung von steuerlichen und rechtlichen Vermögenserhaltungszielen.
• Behalten Sie ein hohes Maß an technischem Know-how in dedizierten Märkten bei und verfolgen Sie einen effektiven, risikobasierten und ergebnisorientierten Ansatz zur Risikominderung.
• Aufbau und Pflege eines Netzwerks von Vermittlern wie Treuhand- und Unternehmensdienstleistern, Steuer- und Anwaltskanzleien. Einhaltung externer und interner Compliance- und regulatorischer Anforderungen, einschließlich der Richtlinien, Betriebsverfahren und Kontrollen der Bank, um die regulatorischen Anforderungen der Bank zu erfüllen und das Unternehmen vor rechtlichen, finanziellen und Reputationsrisiken zu schützen.
• Integration in das lokale Team von Wealth Planern mit Sitz in Zürich; Zusammenarbeit in der UBP Group; Bericht an Head of Wealth Planning – Switzerland mit Sitz in Genf.

• Starker Teamplayer, hoch organisiert mit außergewöhnlicher Liebe zum Detail Dies ist eine 100% ige Rolle in Zürich. Start: asap
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Vous rejoindrez l'équipe de planification de patrimoine de l'Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) à Zurich, en Suisse. Dans ce rôle, vous servirez les clients et travaillerez en partenariat avec les gestionnaires des relations afin de s'assurer que les besoins en matière de planification du patrimoine sont adéquatement pris en compte. Vous fournirez des conseils sur la planification de la relève et de l'héritage, la pertinence fiscale, la planification de la mobilité et la structuration de la richesse – en fonction des circonstances particulières de chaque client – pour créer de la valeur ajoutée et atténuer les risques, en collaborant avec la conformité sur demande afin d'assurer l'alignement avec les exigences de la KYC/AML et les politiques internes. Le rôle consiste également à offrir une formation et des présentations sur les stratégies et les options de planification du patrimoine conformes, à aider les clients à demeurer en avance sur les règlements en évolution rapide et de plus en plus complexes et à protéger leur richesse tout en maximisant les revenus après impôt, et à préparer en temps opportun des alertes internes de planification du patrimoine et des notes de service sur les sujets susmentionnés. Principales responsabilités:
• Engagement proactif auprès des banquiers pour reconnaître et anticiper les besoins des clients, identifier et saisir les occasions d'affaires.
• Fournir et former des banquiers privés avec des informations techniques à jour et pertinentes pour comprendre les évolutions fiscales et juridiques pertinentes et prendre des mesures appropriées.
• Identifier, présenter et discuter des solutions et stratégies de planification de patrimoine appropriées et conformes pour répondre aux besoins des clients : offrir un service personnalisé et des stratégies sur mesure.
• Rencontrer les clients et les perspectives (y compris les voyages d'affaires avec les banquiers)
• Promouvoir activement les services de planification du patrimoine dans l'ensemble de la Banque au moyen de présentations et de publications ponctuelles sur des thèmes choisis à fort impact; soutenir activement les objectifs fiscaux et juridiques de préservation du patrimoine.
• Maintenir un niveau élevé d'expertise technique sur des marchés spécialisés et adopter une approche efficace, axée sur les risques et axée sur les résultats pour atténuer les risques.
• Créer et maintenir un réseau d'intermédiaires tels que les prestataires de services fiduciaires et de services aux entreprises, les cabinets fiscaux et les cabinets d'avocats.
• Se conformer aux exigences de conformité et de réglementation externes et internes, y compris les politiques, les procédures opérationnelles et les contrôles de la Banque pour satisfaire aux exigences de la Banque et de la réglementation et protéger l'entreprise contre les risques juridiques, financiers et de réputation.
• Intégrer avec l'équipe locale de planificateurs de patrimoine basée à Zurich; collaborer à travers le groupe UBP; faire rapport au responsable de la planification de patrimoine – Suisse, basé à Genève.
• Collaborer avec le Département de la conformité pour examiner les cas complexes existants et les structures fiduciaires/propriétés (trusts, fondations, SPV) strictement sur la base de la conformité, sur demande; vérifier la propriété effective et les justifications structurantes des documents conformément aux politiques KYC/AML et aux règles transfrontalières.
• Support à bord pour les clients lourds de structure uniquement sur demande de conformité : identification UBO, justification, documentation requise de l'entité, cartes de propriété et notes de justification pour faciliter l'approbation de conformité.
• Effectuer des examens périodiques et des examens axés sur des événements (p. ex., rafraîchissement du KYC, événements déclencheurs) exclusivement lorsqu'ils sont initiés par Conformité. Exigences:
• 12 ans et plus d'expérience dans les services de planification de patrimoine
• Une expertise approfondie au Royaume-Uni et dans la structuration de la richesse anglo-saxonne, avec un succès prouvé dans ces juridictions.
• Connaissances étendues et avancées dans les disciplines de base de la planification de la richesse (fiscalité, juridique, succession, gouvernance), mises en évidence par l'exécution de cas complexes et l'impact client.
• Études en droit ou en finances; un diplôme en droit et/ou une qualification d'avocat fiscal est un plus
• La maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'allemand; les langues supplémentaires sont un avantage
• Communicateur fiable et persuasif avec d'excellentes compétences de présentation
• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication orale et écrite, avec la capacité de simplifier des sujets complexes pour des publics variés
• Résilient et adaptable : capable de fonctionner sous pression, de prioriser efficacement et de maintenir des normes élevées
• Automotivé, motivé par le service et axé sans relâche sur les résultats des clients
• Fort joueur d'équipe, très organisé avec une attention exceptionnelle au détail C'est un rôle 100% situé à Zurich. Début : dès que possible

jobs.description:
• Mission
 The Intern Pricing Analyst – Securities Master File (6 months) is a critical role within the bank’s Private Banking domain, responsible for the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of security prices across all asset types.
Embedded in the Securities Master File team, this role focuses on the full pricing lifecycle: sourcing, validation, monitoring, exception handling, and controls (including delta checks, missing and stale prices), ensuring robust data quality for front office, risk, operations, performance, and client reporting.

• Duration: 6 months (interim mission)

• Team: Securities Master File (SMF)

• Scope: Pricing for all instruments within Private Banking

• Stakeholders: Front Office, Risk, Operations, Performance, Client Reporting, IT, Procurement, Data Vendors

• Key Responsibilities
• Ensure daily acquisition and validation of prices for all in-scope instruments (equities, fixed income, funds, ETFs, money market, structured products, derivatives, private placement, hedge funds).

• Execute daily pricing control framework:
• Delta price checks vs prior valid prices and tolerances.

• Missing and stale price detection and remediation.

• Ensure pricing hierarchy is well applied according to approved sourcing policies.

• Investigate discrepancies between vendors and coordinate vendor queries, challenges, and corrections.

• Resolve breaks by applying alternative sources, manual validation, or price challenges; document rationales and evidence.

• Pricing exceptions; perform root-cause analysis (stale feeds, mapping, instrument reference data gaps, pricing source provider).

• Coordinate with Corporate Actions, Fund Desk, and Operations to align price effective dates and event impacts (splits, coupons, redemptions, suspensions).

• Execute daily, weekly, and monthly pricing quality KPIs and attestations (e.g., completeness %, stale rate, exception aging, SLA adherence).

• Contribute to enhancement of pricing rules, dashboards, and controls to reduce false positives and improve STP.

• Participate in testing and validation of system changes impacting pricing

• Update and maintain operational procedures (process flows, risks, controls, KPIs) specific to pricing.

• Core Competencies
• Behave Ethically

• Communicate Effectively

• Foster Teamwork

• Creativity/Innovation

• Organize

• Solve Problems

• Specific Competencies
• Economic, mathematical, or quantitative education.

• Solid knowledge of financial instruments and pricing conventions across asset classes.

• Strong prioritization, especially under cut-off pressure and incident scenarios.

• Familiarity with pricing controls: delta checks, stale/missing detection, vendor waterfall logic

• Other Skills/Abilities

• Open mind and team orientation
• Be open to others’ ideas; balance personal and team interests.

• Express opinions and criticism constructively.

• Innovation and development
• Seek opportunities to improve existing controls and processes.

• Be a continuous learner and adopt change with a positive attitude.

• Professional business culture
• Think in Problem–Action–Results terms.

• Go beyond specific assignments and take ownership.

• Be proactive and driven with a strong client service ethic.

• Quality, internal & external regulation
• Consistently comply with internal policies, vendor contracts, and relevant regulations.

• Seek opportunities to improve quality in all aspects of the pricing process.

• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Missione L’Analista dei prezzi interni – Securities Master File (6 mesi) è un ruolo fondamentale nel dominio Private Banking della banca, responsabile dell’accuratezza, della tempestività e dell’integrità dei prezzi di sicurezza in tutti i tipi di asset. Inserito nel team Securities Master File, questo ruolo si concentra sul ciclo di vita dei prezzi completo: sourcing, validazione, monitoraggio, gestione delle eccezioni e controlli (compresi i controlli delta, i prezzi mancanti e stanti), garantendo una robusta qualità dei dati per l'ufficio frontale, il rischio, le operazioni, le prestazioni e la segnalazione dei clienti.
• Durata: 6 mesi ( missione intermedia)
• Team: Securities Master File (SMF)
• Ambito: Prezzo per tutti gli strumenti del Private Banking
• Stakeholders: Front Office, Risk, Operazioni, Performance, Reporting client, IT, Procurement, Data Vendors
• Responsabilità chiave
• Assicurare l'acquisizione quotidiana e la validazione dei prezzi per tutti gli strumenti in-scope (equità, reddito fisso, fondi, ETF, mercato monetario, prodotti strutturati, derivati, collocamento privato, fondi di copertura).
• Eseguire il framework giornaliero di controllo dei prezzi:
• Controlli dei prezzi del Delta rispetto a prezzi e tolleranze valide precedenti.
• Rilevamento e risanamento dei prezzi mancanti e stanti.
• Assicurare la gerarchia dei prezzi è ben applicata in base alle politiche di approvvigionamento approvate.
• Indaga le discrepanze tra i fornitori e coordina le domande dei fornitori, le sfide e le correzioni.
• Risolvere le interruzioni applicando fonti alternative, la validazione manuale o le sfide dei prezzi; documentare razionali e prove.
• Eccezioni di prezzo; eseguire analisi a causa delle radici ( feed di fiabe, mappatura, gap di dati di riferimento dello strumento, fornitore di fonti di prezzi).
• Coordinare le azioni aziendali, il Fondo e le operazioni per allineare le date e gli impatti degli eventi effettivi dei prezzi (split, coupon, redenzioni, sospensioni).
• Eseguire KPI e attestazioni di qualità dei prezzi giornalieri, settimanali e mensili (ad esempio, completezza %, tasso di stallo, invecchiamento delle eccezioni, adesione SLA).
• Contribuire alla valorizzazione delle regole di prezzo, dashboard e controlli per ridurre i falsi positivi e migliorare STP.
• Partecipazione a test e validazione dei cambiamenti di sistema che influiscono sui prezzi
• Aggiornare e mantenere le procedure operative (flussi di processo, rischi, controlli, KPI) specifiche per i prezzi.
• Competenze fondamentali
• Behave Etica
• Comunicare efficacemente
• Foster Teamwork
• Creatività/innovazione
• Organizzare
• risolvere i problemi
• Competenze specifiche
• Istruzione economica, matematica o quantitativa.
• Una solida conoscenza degli strumenti finanziari e delle convenzioni sui prezzi nelle classi di asset.
• Forte prioritizzazione, soprattutto in situazioni di pressione di taglio e incidenti.
• Familiarità con i controlli dei prezzi: controlli delta, rilevamento stallo/missivo, logica della cascata del venditore
• Altre abilità/abilità
• Aprire la mente e l'orientamento del team
• Essere aperti alle idee altrui; bilanciare gli interessi personali e di squadra.
• esprimere opinioni e critiche costruttivamente.
• Innovazione e sviluppo
• Cercate opportunità per migliorare i controlli e i processi esistenti.
• Essere un apprendimento continuo e adottare il cambiamento con un atteggiamento positivo.
• Cultura aziendale professionale
• Pensa ai termini Problem–Action–Risultati.
• Andare oltre incarichi specifici e prendere la proprietà.
• Sii proattivo e guidato con un forte servizio client etico.
• Qualità, regolazione interna ed esterna
• Coerentemente rispettare le politiche interne, i contratti dei fornitori e le normative pertinenti.
• Cercate opportunità per migliorare la qualità in tutti gli aspetti del processo di prezzi.
• Mantenere gli standard di qualità nonostante le pressioni del programma. Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

• Mission L'analyste des prix des stagiaires – Fichier principal des titres (6 mois) est un rôle essentiel dans le domaine de la banque Private Banking, responsable de l'exactitude, de l'actualité et de l'intégrité des prix de la sécurité pour tous les types d'actifs. Intégré à l'équipe du fichier principal des valeurs mobilières, ce rôle se concentre sur le cycle de vie complet des prix : approvisionnement, validation, surveillance, traitement des exceptions et contrôles (y compris les vérifications du delta, les prix manquants et les prix inexistants), assurant une qualité solide des données pour le front office, les risques, les opérations, les performances et les rapports clients.
• Durée: 6 mois (mission provisoire)
• Équipe : fichier principal de titres (SMF)
• Portée: Tarification pour tous les instruments de la banque privée
• Intervenants : Front Office, Risque, Opérations, Performance, Rapports clients, TI, Approvisionnement, Fournisseurs de données
• Principales responsabilités
• Assurer l'acquisition quotidienne et la validation des prix pour tous les instruments de portée (équités, revenus fixes, fonds, ETF, marché monétaire, produits structurés, dérivés, placement privé, fonds spéculatifs).
• Exécuter le cadre de contrôle quotidien des prix:
• Contrôle des prix Delta par rapport aux prix et tolérances antérieurs valables.
• Détection et remise en état des prix manquants et inexistants.
• Veiller à ce que la hiérarchie des prix soit bien appliquée conformément aux politiques d'approvisionnement approuvées.
• Étudier les divergences entre les fournisseurs et coordonner les demandes, les défis et les corrections.
• Résoudre les ruptures en appliquant des sources alternatives, une validation manuelle ou des défis de prix; documenter les justifications et les preuves.
• Exceptions en matière de tarification; analyse des causes profondes (feeds inexistants, cartographie, lacunes dans les données de référence des instruments, fournisseur de sources de tarification).
• Coordonner avec les actions de l'entreprise, le bureau des fonds et les opérations afin d'aligner les dates d'entrée en vigueur des prix et les impacts des événements (splits, coupons, rachats, suspensions).
• Exécuter quotidiennement, hebdomadairement et mensuellement des ICR et des attestations de qualité des prix (par exemple, exhaustivité %, taux d'écart, exception au vieillissement, adhésion à l'ALS).
• Contribuer à l'amélioration des règles de prix, des tableaux de bord et des contrôles pour réduire les faux positifs et améliorer le STP.
• Participer à l'essai et à la validation des changements de système ayant une incidence sur les prix
• Mettre à jour et maintenir les procédures opérationnelles (flux de processus, risques, contrôles, ICR) spécifiques à la tarification.

jobs.description:
• Mission
 The intern will support daily production controls across Investment Operations (Middle Office Wealth & Asset Management, Securities Master File team), to ensure data and process integrity for Private Banking and Asset Management.
The intern will learn core processes, tools, and controls, and contribute to continuous improvement. The role involves monitoring dashboards, investigating exceptions, documenting outcomes, and contributing to control improvements under senior guidance.

• Team: Investment Operations Quality & Business Implementation

• Stakeholders: Middle Office Asset & Wealth Management, Securities Master File team

• Main responsibilities
• Run daily 2nd level controls and sign offs across:
• Trade Processing, Reconciliations, Corporate Actions, Securities Master File & Pricing

• Perform end-of-day sign-offs and maintain audit trails for manual fixes/overrides.

• Update procedures and checklists; contribute to small control/process improvements.

• Collaborate with Middle Office, SMF, Corporate Actions, Performance, and IT for issue resolution.

• Investigate exceptions, document evidence and resolutions; maintain robust audit trails.

• Core Competencies
• Behave Ethically

• Communicate Effectively

• Foster Teamwork

• Creativity/Innovation

• Organize

• Solve Problems

• Specific Competencies
• Economic, mathematical, or quantitative education.

• Solid knowledge of financial instruments.

• Strong prioritization, especially under cut-off pressure and incident scenarios.

• Other Skills/Abilities

• Open mind and team orientation
• Be open to others’ ideas; balance personal and team interests.

• Express opinions and criticism constructively.

• Innovation and development
• Seek opportunities to improve existing controls and processes.

• Be a continuous learner and adopt change with a positive attitude.

• Professional business culture
• Think in Problem–Action–Results terms.

• Go beyond specific assignments and take ownership.

• Be proactive and driven with a strong client service ethic.

• Quality, internal & external regulation
• Consistently comply with internal policies, vendor contracts, and relevant regulations.

• Seek opportunities to improve quality in all aspects of the pricing process.

• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Investment Specialist (Partner Access)
jobs.description:
Mission
 We’re looking for a front-oriented Investment Specialist to advise clients, execute trades, and grow business across our Wealth Management (WM) and External Asset Manager (EAM) segments. You’ll combine revenue generation with strong risk management, client engagement, and continuous process/tool improvement to drive quality, volume, and profitability.
 Main responsibilities
 Advisory & Execution

• Deliver investment advice aligned with UBP’s views and clients’ portfolios

• Receive and execute client orders across channels (Bloomberg, phone, email) with high execution quality

• Internalize flows where possible (Structured Products, AMC, UBAM funds, PMG, OTC derivatives)

Client Engagement

• Proactively share ideas and marketing materials; tailor pitches using portfolio and flow analysis

• Support Relationship Managers in client meetings, prospecting, and follow-ups to deepen relationships and retention

Business Development

• Promote our value-added offering across WM/EAM and within the Bank

• Drive activity, increase transaction volumes, and contribute to PnL

Tools & Process Improvement

• Automate and optimize workflows (VBA/Python/Dashboards) to free time for clients

• Suggest and implement improvements to enhance speed, quality, and control

Risk, Controls & Conduct

• Lead by example with integrity and professionalism

• Adhere to UBP directives and Swiss regulations (FINMA, AML, suitability, cross-border)

• Perform checks, monitor KRIs, remediate issues on time, and complete mandatory trainings/certifications

Your Profile

• Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, or related

• 5–10 years in private banking, sales trading, investment advisory, or structured products (Swiss or international bank).

• Deep knowledge of markets and multi-asset products; experience with structured products, funds, mandates, and vanilla/exotic OTC derivatives

• Proven advisory and execution track record with measurable PnL impact

• Strong understanding of Swiss regulations; risk and control mindset

• Advanced Bloomberg; voice trading (Turret) a plus

• Experience with portfolio management systems

• Technical skills: VBA and/or Python; BI/dashboarding a plus

• Excellent communication; fluent English. French and/or German are strong assets

• Client-centric with commercial drive and negotiation skills

• High vigilance, analytical rigor, and responsiveness under time pressure

• Proactive, innovative, and solution-focused

• Team player; collaborates across WM, EAM, Trading & Treasury, Investment Services, Risk, and Compliance

• Integrity, accountability, and professionalism in all interactions

Others

• Swiss residence mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Contract Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
Role Overview:
 This person provides support to the Hong Kong Compliance team, handling the day-to-day spectrum of compliance activities for the Hong Kong branch, to ensure that the business operations adhere to the requirements of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, Securities and Futures Commission, the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA), and all relevant compliance-related laws and regulations, including anti-money laundering/sanctions/countering of terrorist financing/ anti-bribery and corruption laws and regulations; as well as internal compliance policies and procedures.
 Responsibilities:

• Assist the Head of Financial Crime to establish, review and update the AML related guidelines, policies and procedural manuals to ensure they are in line with Group and regulatory requirements.

• Review and investigate transactions triggered by monitoring systems or escalated by front office or other monitoring parties for potential financial crime risks. Report suspicious transactions and escalate for management oversight timely to ensure adequate follow up actions and ongoing monitoring.

• Monitor effective operation of AML tools and processes for transaction monitoring, client screening, payment screening and client risk assessment. Escalate issues for timely resolution and manage necessary remediation.

• Conduct regular recalibration and tuning of parameters and drive enhancements for AML tools and systems.

• Review escalated alerts stopped on payment screening system and escalate transactions potentially related to money laundering and sanctions.

• Review alerts from ongoing client screening and manage the escalation of true hits for risk reclassification and monitoring follow up actions.

• Trigger follow up actions and KYC updates upon irregularities noted from transaction monitoring or client screening.

• Assist the Head of AML / Compliance in preparing internal AML training materials.

• Prepare materials for periodic AML governance meetings.

• Perform ad hoc tasks as assigned by Head of AML/Compliance from time to time.

• Assist in audits and inspections, and investigations where required

• Involvement in special work projects as and when required

• Assist Head of Compliance, Hong Kong and the Compliance team in any other work matters.

Competencies:

• Basic bachelor degree;

• 5 – 8 years of relevant experience in general compliance and financial crime compliance, preferably in a Hong Kong private bank

• A keen interest to learn and perform compliance matters;

• Good interactive, communication and writing skills;

• Able to provide alternative solutions to business;

• Motivated and innovative; able to handle issues and resolve challenges in collaboration with colleagues;

• Team player

descriptionByLocale.en:
Role Overview:
This person provides support to the Hong Kong Compliance team, handling the day-to-day spectrum of compliance activities for the Hong Kong branch, to ensure that the business operations adhere to the requirements of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, Securities and Futures Commission, the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA), and all relevant compliance-related laws and regulations, including anti-money laundering/sanctions/countering of terrorist financing/ anti-bribery and corruption laws and regulations; as well as internal compliance policies and procedures.
Responsibilities:

• Assist the Head of Financial Crime to establish, review and update the AML related guidelines, policies and procedural manuals to ensure they are in line with Group and regulatory requirements.

• Review and investigate transactions triggered by monitoring systems or escalated by front office or other monitoring parties for potential financial crime risks. Report suspicious transactions and escalate for management oversight timely to ensure adequate follow up actions and ongoing monitoring.

• Monitor effective operation of AML tools and processes for transaction monitoring, client screening, payment screening and client risk assessment. Escalate issues for timely resolution and manage necessary remediation.

• Conduct regular recalibration and tuning of parameters and drive enhancements for AML tools and systems.

• Review escalated alerts stopped on payment screening system and escalate transactions potentially related to money laundering and sanctions.

• Review alerts from ongoing client screening and manage the escalation of true hits for risk reclassification and monitoring follow up actions.

• Trigger follow up actions and KYC updates upon irregularities noted from transaction monitoring or client screening.

• Assist the Head of AML / Compliance in preparing internal AML training materials.

• Prepare materials for periodic AML governance meetings.

• Perform ad hoc tasks as assigned by Head of AML/Compliance from time to time.

• Assist in audits and inspections, and investigations where required

• Involvement in special work projects as and when required

• Assist Head of Compliance, Hong Kong and the Compliance team in any other work matters.

• Basic bachelor degree;

• 5 – 8 years of relevant experience in general compliance and financial crime compliance, preferably in a Hong Kong private bank

• A keen interest to learn and perform compliance matters;

• Good interactive, communication and writing skills;

• Able to provide alternative solutions to business;

• Motivated and innovative; able to handle issues and resolve challenges in collaboration with colleagues;

• Team player

jobs.title: Head of Cyber Security Engineering
jobs.description:
Mission
Lead the Bank’s Cyber Engineering function to design, build, and operate secure-by-design platforms and controls that proactively prevent, detect, and respond to cyber threats. Own the end-to-end engineering roadmap for cyber capabilities, ensuring resilience, reliability, and compliance across hybrid on prem and cloud environments.
 Main responsibilities
• Define and execute the cyber engineering roadmap aligned to the Bank’s risk appetite and business goals.
• Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team across security engineering, DevSecOps, and cyber platform operations.
• Own budget, vendor strategy, and capacity planning for cyber tooling and platforms.
• Establish and enforce security-by-design and security-by-default patterns across infrastructure, applications, and data.
• Industrialize security controls via automation, IaC, and CI/CD integration; shift-left security in development lifecycle.
• Own the roadmap, implementation, and lifecycle management of enterprise-class security platforms (e.g., EDR/XDR, PAM, CSPM, DLP, HSM, etc.).
• Ensure availability, scalability, and performance of cyber platforms with robust SLAs and KPIs.

Your Profile
• Visionary cyber engineering leader with deep hands-on and the ability to translate complex security requirements into scalable engineering solutions.
• Proven experience building and running security platforms in complex, regulated financial environments.

Education
• Master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or related field.
Experience Technical skills
• Senior: 7-10 years of experience.
• 5+ years of experience in Information Security area related to one or more of the following domains: security architecture, security engineering and integration or secure application development.

Languages
• French : fluent
• English : Strong advantage
 Personal skills
• Self-motivated leader with ownership mindset; able to operate strategically while remaining hands-on when needed.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management; able to translate technical risk into business impact.
• Strong critical thinking, analytical problem-solving, and decision-making under pressure.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive complex, multi-department initiatives.
• High integrity, resilience, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Others
• Swiss Residence: Mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione Guidare la funzione Cyber Engineering della Banca per progettare, costruire e gestire piattaforme sicure per design e controlli che proattivamente impediscono, rilevano e rispondono alle minacce informatiche. Proprio la roadmap di ingegneria end-to-end per le capacità informatiche, garantendo resilienza, affidabilità e conformità in ambienti ibridi su prem e cloud. Principali responsabilità
• Definire ed eseguire la roadmap di ingegneria informatica allineato al rischio appetito della Banca e obiettivi di business.
• Costruire, mentore e condurre un team di alta formazione attraverso l'ingegneria della sicurezza, DevSecOps e le operazioni della piattaforma informatica.
• Bilancio proprio, strategia del fornitore e pianificazione della capacità per strumenti informatici e piattaforme.
• Stabilire e far rispettare modelli di sicurezza-by-design e di sicurezza-by-default in infrastrutture, applicazioni e dati.
• Industrializzare i controlli di sicurezza attraverso l'automazione, IaC e l'integrazione CI/CD; sicurezza a turni nel ciclo di vita di sviluppo.
• Possedere la roadmap, l'implementazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita delle piattaforme di sicurezza di classe enterprise (ad esempio, EDR/XDR, PAM, CSPM, DLP, HSM, ecc.).
• Assicurare disponibilità, scalabilità e prestazioni di piattaforme informatiche con robusti SLA e KPI. Il tuo profilo
• Visionary cyber engineering leader con la capacità di tradurre requisiti di sicurezza complessi in soluzioni ingegneristiche scalabili.
• Prove esperienze costruzione e gestione di piattaforme di sicurezza in ambienti finanziari complessi e regolamentati. Istruzione
• Master o laurea in informatica, sicurezza delle informazioni, ingegneria, o campo relativo. Esperienza competenze tecniche
• Senior: 7-10 anni di esperienza.
• 5+ anni di esperienza nell'area di sicurezza dell'informazione relativi a uno o più dei seguenti domini: architettura della sicurezza, ingegneria della sicurezza e integrazione o sviluppo sicuro delle applicazioni. Lingue
• Francese: fluente
• Inglese: Forte vantaggio Capacità personali
• Leader auto-motivato con mentalità di proprietà; in grado di operare strategicamente pur rimanendo hands-on quando necessario.
• Ottima comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder; in grado di tradurre il rischio tecnico in impatto aziendale.
• Forte pensiero critico, problem solving analitico e processo decisionale sotto pressione.
• Prove capacità di guidare squadre interfunzionali e di guidare iniziative complesse e multi-dipartimento.
• Alta integrità, resilienza e impegno al miglioramento continuo. Altri
• Residenza svizzera: obbligatoria Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

jobs.title: Senior Legal Advisor - Management Company (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
• Mission
 As a Senior Legal Advisor specialized in investment funds, you will play a central role within UBP Management Company, UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. You will be involved in a broad range of fund related legal and regulatory matters, including regulatory compliance, fund governance, and structuring of new products.
 You will work closely with all stakeholders of the Management Company, providing legal expertise to support the company’s strategic and operational activities. You will also collaborate daily with our Product Management team and actively contributing to the structuring, management, and evolution of investment products. This key role will allow you to work on diverse projects and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a dynamic and international environment.
 You will also be in charged of the corporate governance of the _Management Company and its branches.

• Your main responsibilities will be:

• Legal Advice :
• Provide legal advice on the company’s activities, particularly in corporate law, investment fund law, and financial law.

• Ensure the company’s activities comply with local and European regulations (CSSF, AIFMD, UCITS, etc.).

• Draft, review, and negotiate contracts, partnership agreements, management mandates, and other legal documents.

• Collaboration with the Product Management Team:
• Work closely with the Product Management team on the structuring, implementation, and management of investment products.

• Provide legal support for the development of new products and the update of existing ones.

• Fund Management:
• Oversee the creation, structuring, and legal management of investment funds (UCITS, AIF, SICAV, FIS, RAIF, etc.).

• Prepare and update legal documentation for funds (prospectus, articles of association, management regulations, etc.).

• Manage relationships with regulatory authorities (CSSF) and follow up on regulatory requests.

• Compliance and Regulatory Monitoring :
• Conduct legal and regulatory monitoring to anticipate legislative changes and their impact on the company’s activities.

• Collaborate with the compliance team to ensure adherence to legal and regulatory obligations.

• Litigation Management :
• Handle potential disputes in collaboration with external law firms.

• Defend the company’s interests in litigation or judicial proceedings.

• Training and Support:
• Train and raise awareness among internal teams about regulatory developments and best legal practices.

• Provide legal support to various departments within the company.

• Your Profile:

• Master’s degree in Business Law, Corporate Law, or Financial Law.

• Specialization in investment fund law or financial law is an asset.

• 5 to 10 years of experience as a legal counsel in a Management Company, law firm, or financial institution in Luxembourg.

• Proved experience in managing investment funds (UCITS, AIF, etc.).

• Excellent knowledge of corporate law, investment fund law, and Luxembourg and European financial regulations (CSSF, AIFMD, UCITS, etc.).

• Proficiency in the processes of structuring and managing investment funds.

• Ability to draft and negotiate complex contracts in both French and English.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Excellent analytical and synthesis skills.

• Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Discretion and respect for confidentiality (knowledge of German or Luxembourgish is an asset).

Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a family-owned company, driven by an entrepreneurial vision, innovation and independence. UBP is one of the most strongly-capitalised private banks.
 By joining UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility.
 UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity.
 In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Missione Come consulente legale senior specializzato in fondi di investimento, si svolgerà un ruolo centrale all'interno della UBP Management Company, UBP Asset Management (Europa) S.A. Sarete coinvolti in una vasta gamma di questioni legali e regolamentari relative ai fondi, tra cui la conformità normativa, la governance dei fondi e la strutturazione di nuovi prodotti. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con tutti gli stakeholder della Società di Gestione, fornendo competenze legali per sostenere le attività strategiche e operative dell'azienda. Potrai anche collaborare quotidianamente con il nostro team di Product Management e contribuire attivamente alla strutturazione, gestione e evoluzione dei prodotti di investimento. Questo ruolo chiave vi permetterà di lavorare su progetti diversi e collaborare con team multidisciplinari in un ambiente dinamico e internazionale. • Fornire supporto legale per lo sviluppo di nuovi prodotti e l'aggiornamento di quelli esistenti.

• Collabora con il team di conformità per garantire l'adesione agli obblighi legali e normativi.

• Difendere gli interessi della società in contenzioso o procedimenti giudiziari.

• Formare e sensibilizzare i gruppi interni sugli sviluppi normativi e sulle migliori pratiche legali.
• Fornire assistenza legale a vari dipartimenti all'interno dell'azienda.

• Laurea magistrale in diritto commerciale, diritto societario o diritto finanziario.
• La specializzazione in diritto dei fondi di investimento o diritto finanziario è un bene.
• da 5 a 10 anni di esperienza come consulente legale in una società di gestione, studio legale o istituzione finanziaria in Lussemburgo.
• Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione dei fondi di investimento (UCITS, AIF, ecc.).
• Ottima conoscenza del diritto societario, del diritto dei fondi di investimento e delle normative finanziarie lussemburghesi ed europee (CSSF, AIFMD, UCITS, ecc.).
• La competenza nei processi di strutturazione e gestione dei fondi di investimento.
• Capacità di redigere e negoziare contratti complessi sia in francese che in inglese.
• Forte capacità organizzative e attenzione ai dettagli.
• Eccellente capacità di analisi e sintesi.
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, collaborando efficacemente con team multidisciplinari.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale.
• Discrezione e rispetto della riservatezza (la conoscenza del tedesco o lussemburghese è un bene). Unendo UBP Asset Management (Europa) S.A. si abbraccia un team di professionisti altamente qualificati di supporto in Private Banking che vi porterà a sviluppare la vostra carriera al livello superiore. Incoraggiamo l'apprendimento continuo, lo sviluppo e la condivisione delle conoscenze. Adottiamo una cultura di Agility, Convizione, Dedicazione e alto grado di Responsabilità. UBP Asset Management (Europa) S.A incoraggia tutti i candidati qualificati e idonei ad applicare indipendentemente dalla loro identità di genere o espressione, età, sfondo razziale, etnico e culturale, religione e credenze, orientamento sessuale, disabilità o neurodiversità. descriptionByLocale.en:
• Mission
As a Senior Legal Advisor specialized in investment funds, you will play a central role within UBP Management Company, UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. You will be involved in a broad range of fund related legal and regulatory matters, including regulatory compliance, fund governance, and structuring of new products.
You will work closely with all stakeholders of the Management Company, providing legal expertise to support the company’s strategic and operational activities. You will also collaborate daily with our Product Management team and actively contributing to the structuring, management, and evolution of investment products. This key role will allow you to work on diverse projects and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a dynamic and international environment.
You will also be in charged of the corporate governance of the _Management Company and its branches.

• Your main responsibilities will be:

• Legal Advice :
• Provide legal advice on the company’s activities, particularly in corporate law, investment fund law, and financial law.

• Ensure the company’s activities comply with local and European regulations (CSSF, AIFMD, UCITS, etc.).

• Draft, review, and negotiate contracts, partnership agreements, management mandates, and other legal documents.

• Collaboration with the Product Management Team:
• Work closely with the Product Management team on the structuring, implementation, and management of investment products.

• Provide legal support for the development of new products and the update of existing ones.

• Fund Management:
• Oversee the creation, structuring, and legal management of investment funds (UCITS, AIF, SICAV, FIS, RAIF, etc.).

• Prepare and update legal documentation for funds (prospectus, articles of association, management regulations, etc.).

• Manage relationships with regulatory authorities (CSSF) and follow up on regulatory requests.

• Compliance and Regulatory Monitoring :
• Conduct legal and regulatory monitoring to anticipate legislative changes and their impact on the company’s activities.

• Collaborate with the compliance team to ensure adherence to legal and regulatory obligations.

• Litigation Management :
• Handle potential disputes in collaboration with external law firms.

• Defend the company’s interests in litigation or judicial proceedings.

• Training and Support:
• Train and raise awareness among internal teams about regulatory developments and best legal practices.

• Provide legal support to various departments within the company.

• Your Profile:

• Master’s degree in Business Law, Corporate Law, or Financial Law.

• Specialization in investment fund law or financial law is an asset.

• 5 to 10 years of experience as a legal counsel in a Management Company, law firm, or financial institution in Luxembourg.

• Proved experience in managing investment funds (UCITS, AIF, etc.).

• Excellent knowledge of corporate law, investment fund law, and Luxembourg and European financial regulations (CSSF, AIFMD, UCITS, etc.).

• Proficiency in the processes of structuring and managing investment funds.

• Ability to draft and negotiate complex contracts in both French and English.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Excellent analytical and synthesis skills.

• Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Discretion and respect for confidentiality (knowledge of German or Luxembourgish is an asset).

Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a family-owned company, driven by an entrepreneurial vision, innovation and independence. UBP is one of the most strongly-capitalised private banks.
By joining UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility.
UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity.
In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.
descriptionByLocale.de:
• Mission Als Senior Legal Advisor, spezialisiert auf Investmentfonds, spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle innerhalb der UBP Management Company, UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. Sie werden in eine breite Palette von fondsbezogenen rechtlichen und regulatorischen Angelegenheiten involviert sein, einschließlich der Einhaltung von Vorschriften, der Fondsverwaltung und der Strukturierung neuer Produkte. Sie werden eng mit allen Stakeholdern der Managementgesellschaft zusammenarbeiten und rechtliche Expertise zur Unterstützung der strategischen und operativen Aktivitäten des Unternehmens bereitstellen. Sie arbeiten auch täglich mit unserem Produktmanagement-Team zusammen und tragen aktiv zur Strukturierung, Verwaltung und Entwicklung von Anlageprodukten bei. Diese Schlüsselrolle ermöglicht es Ihnen, an verschiedenen Projekten zu arbeiten und mit multidisziplinären Teams in einem dynamischen und internationalen Umfeld zusammenzuarbeiten. Sie sind auch für die Corporate Governance der Management Company und ihrer Niederlassungen verantwortlich.
• Ihre Hauptaufgaben werden sein:
• Rechtsberatung:
• Rechtsberatung zu den Aktivitäten des Unternehmens, insbesondere im Gesellschaftsrecht, im Investmentfondsrecht und im Finanzrecht.
• Sicherstellen, dass die Aktivitäten des Unternehmens den lokalen und europäischen Vorschriften (CSSF, AIFMD, UCITS usw.) entsprechen.
• Entwurf, Überprüfung und Verhandlung von Verträgen, Partnerschaftsvereinbarungen, Managementmandaten und anderen rechtlichen Dokumenten.
• Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktmanagement-Team:
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Produktmanagement-Team bei der Strukturierung, Implementierung und Verwaltung von Anlageprodukten zusammen.
• Bieten Sie rechtliche Unterstützung für die Entwicklung neuer Produkte und die Aktualisierung bestehender.
• Fondsverwaltung:
• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Einrichtung, Strukturierung und rechtliche Verwaltung von Investmentfonds (OGAW, AIF, SICAV, FIS, RAIF usw.).
• Erstellung und Aktualisierung der rechtlichen Dokumentation für Fonds (Prospekt, Satzung, Verwaltungsvorschriften usw.).
• Verwalten Sie die Beziehungen zu den Regulierungsbehörden (CSSF) und verfolgen Sie regulatorische Anfragen.
• Compliance und regulatorische Überwachung:
• Durchführung einer rechtlichen und regulatorischen Überwachung, um Gesetzesänderungen und deren Auswirkungen auf die Aktivitäten des Unternehmens zu antizipieren.
• Arbeiten Sie mit dem Compliance-Team zusammen, um die Einhaltung gesetzlicher und regulatorischer Verpflichtungen sicherzustellen.
• Litigation Management:
• Umgang mit möglichen Streitigkeiten in Zusammenarbeit mit externen Anwaltskanzleien.
• Verteidigung der Interessen des Unternehmens in Rechtsstreitigkeiten oder Gerichtsverfahren.
• Schulung und Unterstützung:
• Schulung und Sensibilisierung der internen Teams für regulatorische Entwicklungen und bewährte Rechtspraktiken.
• Bieten Sie rechtliche Unterstützung für verschiedene Abteilungen innerhalb des Unternehmens.
• Ihr Profil:
• Master-Abschluss in Wirtschaftsrecht, Gesellschaftsrecht oder Finanzrecht.
• Spezialisierung auf Investmentfondsrecht oder Finanzrecht ist ein Vermögenswert.
• 5 bis 10 Jahre Erfahrung als Rechtsberater in einer Verwaltungsgesellschaft, Anwaltskanzlei oder einem Finanzinstitut in Luxemburg.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Investmentfonds (OGAW, AIF usw.).
• Ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse des Gesellschaftsrechts, des Investmentfondsrechts sowie der luxemburgischen und europäischen Finanzvorschriften (CSSF, AIFMD, UCITS usw.).
• Kenntnisse in den Prozessen der Strukturierung und Verwaltung von Investmentfonds.
• Fähigkeit, komplexe Verträge in Französisch und Englisch zu entwerfen und auszuhandeln.
• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Liebe zum Detail.
• Hervorragende analytische und Synthesefähigkeiten.
• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig effektiv mit multidisziplinären Teams zusammenzuarbeiten.
• Hervorragende schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
• Diskretion und Wahrung der Vertraulichkeit (Kenntnisse von Deutsch oder Luxemburgisch sind ein Aktivposten). Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) ist ein Familienunternehmen, das von einer unternehmerischen Vision, Innovation und Unabhängigkeit geprägt ist. UBP ist eine der am stärksten kapitalisierten Privatbanken. Wenn Sie zu UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. kommen, werden Sie ein Team von hochqualifizierten Fachkräften im Private Banking unterstützen, das Sie dazu bringt, Ihre Karriere auf höchstem Niveau zu entwickeln. Wir fördern kontinuierliches Lernen, Entwicklung und Wissensaustausch. Wir fördern eine Kultur der Agilität, Überzeugung, Hingabe und ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung. UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. ermutigt alle geeigneten qualifizierten und qualifizierten Kandidaten, sich unabhängig von ihrer Geschlechtsidentität oder -ausdruck, Alter, Rasse, ethnischen und kulturellen Hintergrund, Religion und Überzeugung, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Neurodiversität zu bewerben. Gemäß den Bestimmungen des luxemburgischen Gesetzes vom 23. Juli 2016 zur Änderung des Gesetzes vom 29. März 2013 müssen die ausgewählten Kandidaten im Rahmen des UBP-Screenings einen Auszug aus ihrem Strafregister vorlegen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
• Mission En tant que conseiller juridique principal spécialisé dans les fonds d'investissement, vous jouerez un rôle central au sein de UBP Management Company, UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. Vous participerez à un large éventail de questions juridiques et réglementaires liées au fonds, y compris la conformité réglementaire, la gouvernance du fonds et la structuration de nouveaux produits. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec tous les intervenants de la société de gestion, fournissant une expertise juridique pour soutenir les activités stratégiques et opérationnelles de la société. Vous collaborerez également quotidiennement avec notre équipe de gestion des produits et contribuerez activement à la structuration, à la gestion et à l'évolution des produits d'investissement. Ce rôle clé vous permettra de travailler sur divers projets et de collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires dans un environnement dynamique et international. Vous serez également chargé de la gouvernance d'entreprise de la Management Company et de ses succursales.
• Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :
• Conseil juridique :
• Fournir des conseils juridiques sur les activités de la société, en particulier en droit des sociétés, en droit des fonds d'investissement et en droit financier.
• Veiller à ce que les activités de l'entreprise respectent les réglementations locales et européennes (CSSF, AIFMD, OPCVM, etc.).
• Ébauche, examen et négociation des contrats, des ententes de partenariat, des mandats de gestion et d'autres documents juridiques.
• Collaboration avec l'équipe de gestion des produits :
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de gestion des produits sur la structuration, la mise en œuvre et la gestion des produits d'investissement.
• Fournir un soutien juridique pour le développement de nouveaux produits et la mise à jour des produits existants.
• Gestion du fonds :
• Superviser la création, la structuration et la gestion juridique des fonds d'investissement (OPCVM, AIF, SICAV, FIS, RAIF, etc.).
• Préparer et mettre à jour la documentation juridique des fonds (prospectus, statuts, règlements de gestion, etc.).
• Gérer les relations avec les autorités réglementaires (CSSF) et assurer le suivi des demandes réglementaires.
• Conformité et surveillance réglementaire :
• Effectuer un suivi juridique et réglementaire pour anticiper les changements législatifs et leur impact sur les activités de l'entreprise.
• Collaborer avec l'équipe de conformité pour assurer le respect des obligations légales et réglementaires.
• Gestion des litiges :
• Traiter les différends potentiels en collaboration avec des cabinets d'avocats externes.
• Défendre les intérêts de la société dans les litiges ou les procédures judiciaires.
• Formation et soutien :
• Former et sensibiliser les équipes internes à l'évolution de la réglementation et aux meilleures pratiques juridiques.
• Fournir un soutien juridique aux divers ministères de l'entreprise.
• Votre profil:
• Maîtrise en droit des affaires, droit des sociétés ou droit financier.
• La spécialisation en droit des fonds de placement ou en droit financier est un actif.
• 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en tant que conseiller juridique dans une société de gestion, un cabinet d'avocats ou une institution financière au Luxembourg.
• Expérience acquise dans la gestion des fonds d'investissement (OPCVM, FIA, etc.).
• Excellente connaissance du droit des sociétés, du droit des fonds d'investissement, du Luxembourg et de la réglementation financière européenne (CSSF, AIFMD, OPCVM, etc.).
• Maîtrise des processus de structuration et de gestion des fonds d'investissement.
• Capacité de rédiger et de négocier des contrats complexes en français et en anglais.
• Fortes compétences organisationnelles et attention aux détails.
• Excellente capacité d'analyse et de synthèse.
• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante tout en collaborant efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires.
• Excellente capacité de communication écrite et verbale.
• Discrétion et respect de la confidentialité (la connaissance de l'allemand ou du luxembourgeois est un atout). Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) est une entreprise familiale, animée par une vision entrepreneuriale, l'innovation et l'indépendance. UBP est l'une des banques privées les plus fortement capitalisées. En rejoignant UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A., vous allez embrasser une équipe de professionnels de haut niveau en banque privée qui vous mènera à développer votre carrière au plus haut niveau. Nous encourageons l'apprentissage continu, le développement et le partage des connaissances. Nous favorisons une culture de l'agilité, de la condamnation, de la dédicace et du haut degré de responsabilité. UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A encourage tous les candidats qualifiés et éligibles à postuler indépendamment de leur identité ou expression de genre, de leur âge, de leur origine raciale, ethnique et culturelle, de leur religion et de leurs croyances, de leur orientation sexuelle, de leur handicap ou de leur neurodiversité. Conformément aux dispositions de la loi luxembourgeoise du 23 juillet 2016 modifiant la loi du 29 mars 2013, le candidat retenu sera tenu de fournir un extrait de son casier judiciaire dans le cadre du processus de contrôle UBP.

jobs.title: Head of Securities Transfer
jobs.description:
• Mission

• Support and be able to treat all processing covering the management of activities relating to Securities Transfer changes which will affect all kind of assets (including alternative assets such as mutual funds, Private Equities and Hedge Funds).

• Manage and oversee a team processing in light of the funds activities including private equities.

• Be able to work closely with our key players to meet our customers' expectations.

• Be responsible to lead, mentor staff and provide oversight to ensure events are processed timely and accurately. Be able to work closely with our key players to meet our customers' expectations.

Management responsibilities:

• Present strategic opportunities to mitigate risk.

• Maintain our KPI/KRI indices internal to our business with a view to mitigating the risk associated with the securities transfer activities.

• Be responsible for its activity by working closely with the various divisions of the bank in order to be up to date with the various regulations impacting our securities transfer activity.

• Ensure department procedures are adhered to, review and maintain client task list and related SLA's.

• Communicate effectively and efficiently across departments, with staff, with senior management.

• Lead staff meetings, participate on project management and industry events.

• Ensure daily follow up in respect of pending issues and take appropriate measures for resolution.

Daily business responsibilities:

• Crossed analysis of the received information: custodian’s swifts, agent prospectus, contract notes and financial providers such as: Bloomberg, Telekurs.

• Perform control of reconciliation of holdings, entitlements determination, pending positions management.

• Be able to manage and control securities transfer instructions received from Wealth Management and external parties (transfer IN/OUT/Internal and funds registration process).

• Control transmission of the deposits to our correspondents/Transfer Agents/Administrators and control of their safe delivery and acceptance.

• Follow-up of the topics and issues over the lifecycle of the securities transfer activities.

• Your Profile

• Education : Bachelor’s degree

• Languages : French and English: fluent

• Personal skills:
• Think in "Problem-Action-Results" terms.

• Be proactive and driven.

• Show strong client service ethic.

• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures.

• Highly organized, manage tight deadlines within a high risk environment, ability to work under pressure.

• Strong analytical skills with an ability to identify problems and propose solutions.

• Express opinions and criticism in a constructive way.

• Be a continuous learner.

• Adaptability, self-motivation and team work.

• Build lasting client relationships.

• Consistently comply with internal & external regulations.

• Strong analytical skills and organized.

• Attention to detail and accuracy.

• Others
• Swiss Residence: Mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Missione
• Sostegno ed essere in grado di trattare tutti i trattamenti che coprono la gestione delle attività relative ai cambiamenti di trasferimento delle valute che influenzeranno tutti i tipi di attività (comprese le attività alternative come fondi comuni, azioni private e fondi di copertura).
• Gestire e supervisionare un team di elaborazione alla luce delle attività dei fondi, comprese le azioni private.
• Essere in grado di lavorare a stretto contatto con i nostri giocatori chiave per soddisfare le aspettative dei nostri clienti.
• Sii responsabile di guidare, il personale del mentore e fornire la supervisione per garantire che gli eventi siano elaborati con tempestività e precisione. Essere in grado di lavorare a stretto contatto con i nostri giocatori chiave per soddisfare le aspettative dei nostri clienti. Responsabilità di gestione:
• Presentare opportunità strategiche per mitigare il rischio.
• Mantenere i nostri indici KPI/KRI interni alla nostra azienda al fine di mitigare il rischio associato alle attività di trasferimento dei titoli.
• Sii responsabile della sua attività lavorando a stretto contatto con le varie divisioni della banca per essere aggiornato con le varie normative che influenzano la nostra attività di trasferimento di titoli.
• Assicurare le procedure di reparto sono aderenti, rivedere e mantenere la lista delle attività del cliente e relativi SLA.
• Comunicare efficacemente ed efficacemente in tutti i reparti, con il personale, con la gestione senior.
• Conduci riunioni del personale, partecipare alla gestione del progetto e eventi del settore.
• Assicurarsi di seguire ogni giorno le questioni in sospeso e prendere misure appropriate per la risoluzione. Responsabilità aziendali quotidiane:
• Analisi incrociata delle informazioni ricevute: veloci del custode, prospetto agente, note contrattuali e fornitori finanziari come: Bloomberg, Telekurs.
• Esegui il controllo della riconciliazione delle aziende, la determinazione dei diritti, la gestione delle posizioni in sospeso.
• Essere in grado di gestire e controllare le istruzioni di trasferimento dei titoli ricevuti da Wealth Management e parti esterne (trasferire IN/OUT/Internal e fondi processo di registrazione).
• Trasmissione di controllo dei depositi ai nostri corrispondenti/Agenzie di trasferimento/Amministratori e controllo della loro consegna sicura e accettazione.
• Seguire gli argomenti e le questioni relative al ciclo di vita delle attività di trasferimento dei titoli.
• Il tuo profilo
• Istruzione: laurea
• Lingue: Francese e Inglese: fluente
• Competenze personali:
• Pensa in termini "Problem-Action-Results".
• Sii proattivo e guidato.
• Mostra forte servizio client etico.
• Mantenere gli standard di qualità nonostante le pressioni del programma.
• Altamente organizzato, gestire scadenze strette all'interno di un ambiente ad alto rischio, capacità di lavorare sotto pressione.
• Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di identificare i problemi e proporre soluzioni.
• Esprimi opinioni e critiche in modo costruttivo.
• Sii un apprendista continuo.
• Adaptability, automotivation e lavoro di squadra.
• Costruire relazioni cliente durature.
• Conformemente alle normative interne ed esterne.
• Forte capacità analitiche e organizzato.
• Attenzione ai dettagli e alla precisione.
• Altri
• Residenza svizzera: obbligatoria Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

• Mission
• Unterstützen und in der Lage sein, alle Verarbeitungen zu behandeln, die die Verwaltung von Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit Änderungen der Wertpapierübertragung betreffen, die alle Arten von Vermögenswerten betreffen (einschließlich alternativer Vermögenswerte wie Investmentfonds, Private Equities und Hedgefonds).
• Verwalten und beaufsichtigen Sie eine Teambearbeitung im Lichte der Fondsaktivitäten, einschließlich Private Equity.
• Wir können eng mit unseren Key Playern zusammenarbeiten, um die Erwartungen unserer Kunden zu erfüllen.
• Seien Sie dafür verantwortlich, das Personal zu leiten, zu betreuen und die Aufsicht zu übernehmen, um sicherzustellen, dass Ereignisse rechtzeitig und genau verarbeitet werden. Wir können eng mit unseren Key Playern zusammenarbeiten, um die Erwartungen unserer Kunden zu erfüllen. Verwaltungszuständigkeiten:
• Präsentieren Sie strategische Chancen zur Risikominderung.
• Pflegen Sie unsere internen KPI / KRI-Indizes, um das mit den Wertpapiertransferaktivitäten verbundene Risiko zu mindern.
• Seien Sie für seine Tätigkeit verantwortlich, indem Sie eng mit den verschiedenen Abteilungen der Bank zusammenarbeiten, um mit den verschiedenen Vorschriften, die sich auf unsere Wertpapiertransferaktivitäten auswirken, auf dem Laufenden zu sein.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Verfahren der Abteilung eingehalten werden, überprüfen und pflegen Sie die Aufgabenliste der Kunden und die damit verbundenen SLAs.
• Kommunizieren Sie effektiv und effizient über Abteilungen hinweg, mit Mitarbeitern und mit der Geschäftsleitung.
• Leiten Sie Mitarbeiterbesprechungen, nehmen Sie an Projektmanagement- und Branchenveranstaltungen teil.
• Gewährleistung der täglichen Nachverfolgung von anhängigen Problemen und Ergreifung geeigneter Maßnahmen zur Lösung. Tägliche Geschäftsverantwortung:
• Kreuzanalyse der erhaltenen Informationen: Treuhänder, Agentenprospekt, Vertragsanweisungen und Finanzdienstleister wie: Bloomberg, Telekurs.
• Kontrolle der Überleitung von Beteiligungen, der Bestimmung von Anspruchen und der Verwaltung von ausstehenden Positionen.
• In der Lage sein, die von Wealth Management und externen Parteien erhaltenen Wertpapiertransferanweisungen zu verwalten und zu kontrollieren (Transfer IN / Out / Intern und Fondsregistrierungsprozess).
• Kontrolle der Übertragung der Einzahlungen an unsere Korrespondenten/Transferagenten/Administratoren und Kontrolle ihrer sicheren Lieferung und Annahme.
• Follow-up der Themen und Themen über den Lebenszyklus der Wertpapiertransferaktivitäten.
• Ihr Profil
• Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss
• Sprachen : Französisch und Englisch: fließend
• Persönliche Fähigkeiten:
• Denken Sie in "Problem-Action-Ergebnisse" Begriffe.
• Seien Sie proaktiv und motiviert.
• Zeigen Sie eine starke Kundendienstethik.

 Associate

POSITION:
 Talent Manager

 Head of HR

 No

 No
