 No

LAST UPDATED:
 Febuary 2026

Main Responsibilities
 This role is primarily responsible for UBP UK's Talent Acquisition, learning and development, training.

Role Duties

Recruitment Lead
 • Talent Acquisition Strategy: Develop and execute a recruitment strategy to attract top-tier talent.
 • Candidate Sourcing & Selection: Source, screen, and interview candidates for a variety of roles across UBP UK,
 ensuring a seamless and professional candidate experience.
 • Recruitment Partnerships: Manage relationships with external recruitment agencies, including maintaining and
 optimising the preferred supplier list, negotiating terms, and ensuring service level agreements are met.
 • Collaboration with HR Business Partners: Work closely with HRBPs to understand workforce planning needs,
 provide market insights, and deliver tailored recruitment solutions.
 • Benchmarking & Market Analysis: Conduct market research and benchmarking to ensure competitive
 compensation and benefits for open positions.
 • Recruitment Tools & Systems: Utilise our new tool Oracle HCM to post job openings, manage candidate
 pipelines, and track recruitment metrics. Delegate tasks to the HR Administrative team as appropriate.
 • Graduate Programme: lead and oversee UBP UK's graduate programme, working closely with colleagues in
 Genova.

Learning & Development
 • Learning Strategy: Design and implement a learning and development strategy that aligns with UBP UK's
 business objectives and promotes a culture of continuous learning.
 • Training Needs: Partner with business leaders and HRBPs to identify skill gaps and training needs.
 • Training: Develop, source, and implement training programmes, workshops, and e-learning solutions to address
 identified needs, collaborating with Geneva L&D team where training is organised centrally.
 • Mandatory training: work with Compliance, Risk and other teams to issue mandatory training for staff on a biannual
 basis, reviewing training from our system LRN and working with them to amend where appropriate.
 Union Bancaire Privée, UBP SA I Human Resources I Job Description I October 2023 1 3

UNION BANCAIRE PRIVÉE
 • Vendor Management: Identify, evaluate, and manage external training providers.
 • Training Delivery: Facilitate and deliver, or support the delivery of training sessions, workshops, and leadership
 development programmes as needed.
 • Evaluation & Reporting: Measure the effectiveness of training initiatives through feedback, assessments, and
 performance metrics, and use insights to continuously improve programmes. Monitor training hours, study leave,
 and completion records of mandatory training.
 • Corporate title & promotions: Manage the annual process for promotions nominations, working closely with the
 HRBPs.

Other
 • Diversity & Inclusion: Collaborate with leadership to develop and implement initiatives that promote diversity,
 equity, and inclusion.
 • Employee Engagement: Design and execute engagement initiatives to promote a positive and inclusive workplace
 culture.
 • Succession planning and talent management: Work with HRBPs and leadership to deliver succession planning
 and talent management for key roles, ensuring key action plans are in place to address any gaps or support further
 development.
 Conduct Rules
 This role is required to comply with the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) Individual Conduct Rules, which are:

• To act with integrity;

• To act with due skill, care and diligence;

• To be open and cooperative with the FCA, the Prudential Regulation Authoritity (PRA) and other regulators;

• To pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly; 5. To observe proper standards of market conduct; and 6. To act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.

Person Specification
 Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Strong experience in recruitment and learning and development.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with internal and
 external stakeholders.
 • Strategic thinker with the ability to align talent strategies with business objectives.
 • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
 • Experience in designing and delivering training programmes.
 • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and provide actionable insights.

Competencies and Values Required Level

Role Duties Piombo di reclutamento
• Talent Acquisition Strategy: Sviluppare ed eseguire una strategia di reclutamento per attrarre talenti.
• Candidate Sourcing & Selezione: Fonte, schermo e candidati intervista per una varietà di ruoli in UBP UK, garantire un'esperienza candidata senza soluzione di continuità e professionale.
• Partenariati di reclutamento: gestire i rapporti con le agenzie di reclutamento esterne, tra cui il mantenimento e ottimizzare l'elenco dei fornitori preferiti, negoziare i termini e garantire accordi di livello di servizio.
• Collaborazione con HR Business Partners: lavorare a stretto contatto con HRBP per comprendere le esigenze di pianificazione della forza lavoro, fornire informazioni sul mercato e fornire soluzioni di reclutamento su misura.
• Benchmarking & Market Analysis: condurre ricerche di mercato e benchmarking per garantire la competitività compensazione e benefici per posizioni aperte.
• Strumenti di reclutamento & Sistemi: Utilizzare il nostro nuovo strumento Oracle HCM per pubblicare le aperture di lavoro, gestire il candidato pipelines, e traccia metriche di reclutamento. Delegare le attività al team di amministrazione delle risorse umane come opportuno.
• Programma di laurea: guidare e supervisionare il programma di laurea UBP UK, lavorando a stretto contatto con i colleghi in Genova. Apprendimento e Sviluppo
• Learning Strategy: Progettazione e realizzazione di una strategia di apprendimento e sviluppo che si allinea con UBP UK obiettivi aziendali e promuove una cultura dell'apprendimento continuo.
• Bisogno di formazione: Partner con i leader aziendali e HRBP per identificare le lacune di abilità e le esigenze di formazione.
• Formazione: sviluppo, fonte e attuazione di programmi di formazione, workshop e soluzioni di apprendimento per affrontare ha individuato le esigenze, collaborando con il team di Ginevra L&D dove la formazione è organizzata in modo centralizzato.
• Formazione obbligatoria: lavoro con Compliance, Risk e altre squadre per impartire formazione obbligatoria per il personale su un semestrale base, revisione della formazione dal nostro sistema LRN e lavorare con loro per modificare, se del caso. Union Bancaire Privée, UBP SA I Human Resources I Job Description I October 2023 1 3 UNION BANCAIRE PRIVÉE
• Gestione del Fornitore: Identificare, valutare e gestire fornitori di formazione esterni.
• Consegna della formazione: Facilitare e consegnare, o sostenere la consegna di sessioni di formazione, workshop e leadership programmi di sviluppo come necessario.
• Valutazione & Reporting: Misurare l'efficacia delle iniziative di formazione attraverso feedback, valutazioni e metriche di performance e utilizzare insight per migliorare continuamente i programmi. Monitorare le ore di allenamento, lasciare lo studio, e registri di completamento della formazione obbligatoria.
• Titolo aziendale & promozioni: Gestisci il processo annuale per le candidature delle promozioni, lavorando a stretto contatto con HRBPs. Altri
• Diversità & Inclusione: Collabora con la leadership per sviluppare e implementare iniziative che promuovono la diversità, equità e inclusione.
• Impegno dei dipendenti: Progettare ed eseguire iniziative di impegno per promuovere un posto di lavoro positivo e inclusivo cultura.
• Pianificazione di successione e gestione del talento: lavorare con HRBP e leadership per fornire pianificazione di successione e gestione del talento per ruoli chiave, assicurando piani di azione chiave sono in atto per affrontare eventuali lacune o sostenere ulteriormente sviluppo. Regole di condotta Questo ruolo è tenuto a rispettare le regole di condotta individuale dell’Autorità di conduzione finanziaria (FCA) che sono:
• agire con integrità;
• agire con la dovuta abilità, cura e diligenza;
• Per essere aperta e cooperativa con la FCA, l'Autorita` del Regolamento prudenziale (PRA) e altri regolatori;
• Per pagare il dovuto rispetto degli interessi dei clienti e trattarli in modo equo; 5. per rispettare gli standard adeguati di comportamento di mercato; e 6. Per agire per fornire buoni risultati per i clienti al dettaglio. Specificazione della persona Conoscenza, competenze e esperienza Forte esperienza nel reclutamento e nell'apprendimento e nello sviluppo.
• Eccellente capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione, con la capacità di costruire relazioni forti con interni e stakeholder esterni.
• Pensatore strategico con la capacità di allineare le strategie di talento con gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Forte capacità di gestione del progetto, con la capacità di gestire più priorità e rispettare le scadenze.
• Esperienza nella progettazione e realizzazione di programmi di formazione.
• Mindset analitico con la capacità di interpretare i dati e fornire intuizioni attuabili. Competenze e Valori Livello richiesto Mostra l'unità per eseguire e avere successo 4 Persistente nel follow-up e attraverso i problemi 4 Ritiene lo standard legale, normativo ed etico del Gruppo UBP 4 Buona conoscenza del prodotto 4 Conoscenza dei requisiti normativi e industriali 4 Sviluppo delle imprese 4 Comunicazione - ascolto, scritto e verbale con i clienti 3 Influenza 3 Conoscenza dei prodotti e dei servizi 4 Costruzione di relazioni - interno ed esterno 4 Sensibilizzazione strategica e commerciale 4 Pianificazione e organizzazione 4 Etica e valori 4 Obiettivo del cliente 4 Spiegazione: 1: basso livello di competenza / competenze richieste, 2-3: livello medio di competenza / competenze richieste, 4-5: alto livello di competenza necessaria

Job description
 Multi-skilled Maintenance Technician

NAME:

CORPORATE JOB TITLE:
 Multi-skilled Maintenance Technician

POSITION:
 Associate

REPORTS TO:
 Facilities Manager

SIGNIFICANT MANAGEMENT FUNCTION (YES/NO):
 No

PRESCRIBED RESPONSBILITY:
 N/A

MATERIAL RISK TAKER (YES/NO):
 No

CERTIFIED (YES/NO):
 No

CERTIFIED (YES/NO):
 N/A

LAST UPDATED:
 June 2026

Main Responsibilities
 The Multi-skilled Maintenance Technician role is a key member of the Facilities team whose primary role is to assist the Facilities Manager in the day-to-day building and facilities operations, including carrying out general maintenance, portering, spatial arrangement, furniture (chairs, desks, lockers, pedestal & key) management within the office building, monitoring compliance, liaison with the Physical Security on Access Passes and overseeing deliveries when required, and maintaining safe-keeping of the doors’ keys to allow access for maintenance and repairs on a day-to-day basis.

Role Duties
 General Security BAU

• Under the supervision of the Facilities Manager, the duty holder will be responsible for minor reactive maintenance, PPMs, furniture rearrangement, equipment ad-hoc repairs, and general upkeep of the building fabric.

• To assist with any reactive or planned preventative maintenance which may include plumbing tasks required throughout the office - i.e., Changing taps, unblocked toilet, mending leaks, and replacing toilets seats, etc.

• To carry out minor planned and unplanned general maintenance duties related to the building infrastructures, mechanical plants and equipment systems and to complete relevant paperwork in connection with the above works.

• Experience in multi skilled trades and general handyperson duties (e.g. carpentry, tilling, changing locks, etc).

• To respond to any facilities maintenance requests made by staff timely, efficiently and to a high standard.

• To work co-operatively with other departments especially the Communications Teams, Catering and IT as well as external stakeholders on facilities issues, and provide support where required.

• To be available for occasional emergency call outs outside normal business hours to respond to maintenance emergencies evenings or weekends as may requested by the Facilities Manager.

• To act in the role of Fire Marshal and be part of the Fire Safety Team during fire emergency evacuation.

• Provide necessary support during fire evacuation, 6-monthly fire drill and weekly fire alarm testing.

• To complete periodic checks of the building infrastructural assets and report back to the Facilities Manager.

• Monitor access, and respond to security or safety alerts and incidents.

• Overseeing deliveries and signing for packages when required.

• Keeping fire evacuation exit doors cleared of obstructions.

• Internal spaces arrangement for meetings and events as required by the organisers or Facilities Manager.

• Contributing to the maintenance of the building by reporting faults or damage to fittings and fixtures , and coordinate with outsourced maintenance teams for repairs.

• Proficiency with computer systems for record-keeping, CCTV monitoring, and other administrative tasks.

• Monitoring daily, weekly or monthly waste collections, including general, food, mixed recycling, WEEE, sanitary and confidential wastes.

• Monthly utilities meters readings – i.e., Water and Electricity.

• To undertake any other duties within the competence of the post holder, as may be required from time to time.

•
 The job description is not exhaustive and may include other duties as assigned from time to time by management .

Number of Post & Working Hours

• This is a single position and the duty holder will work as Multi-skilled Maintenance Technician.

• The working hours is: 0800 – 1700 Monday to Friday and as may be required by the business.

•
 Business Continuity

• Remote Working – N/A.

Committee Membership

• None

Conduct Rules
 This role is required to comply with the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) Individual Conduct Rules, which are:

• To act with integrity;

• To act with due skill, care and diligence;

• To be open and cooperative with the FCA, the Prudential Regulation Authoritity (PRA) and other regulators;

• To pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly;

• To observe proper standards of market conduct; and

• To act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.

Person Specification
 Knowledge, Skills & Experience

• Able to move furniture items of over 20kg.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to maintain positive attitude and professional tone all time.

• Candidates who have worked as a Facilities Assistant, Building Technician, Estates Coordinator or General Multi-skilled Technician/Handyperson.

• Able to respond appropriately with quick thinking and decision making even when they are put on the spot.

• Overseeing the safe keeping of the building’s keys to allow access for maintenance and repairs when necessary.

• Candidates that have worked in financial institutions, hospitality or similar environment and have experience of multitasking, maintaining a professional attitude and delivering excellent customer service.

• Persons specified must possess general building and facilities training gaining through formal education or hands-on, and should have minimum of GCSE passes or equivalent, particularly in English and Math.

• Candidates that speak more than one language have an advantage, as do those who have completed training in facilities management, moving and handling, health and safety or customer service.

• Competent with tools to assist with basic premises issues.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, to deal with staff of all levels.

•
 Competencies and Values Required Level

Facilities and customer focus 4
 Shows the drive to perform and be successful 4
 Persistent in following up and through on issues 3
 Upholds the legal, regulatory and ethical standard of the UBP Group 2
 Good product knowledge 1
 Knowledge of legal regulatory and industry requirements 1
 Business Development 1
 Communication - listening, written and verbal with clients 3
 Influencing 1
 Knowledge of Products and Services 1
 Relationship Building - internal and external 3
 Strategic & commercial awareness 1
 Planning & organising 2
 Ethics and values 4

Explanation: 1: low level of competence / skill required, 2-3: average level of competence / skill required, 4-5: high level of competence skill required

Descrizione del lavoro Tecnico di manutenzione multi-skilled Nome: CORPORATE JOB TITOLO: Tecnico di manutenzione multi-skilled POSIZIONE: Associati RELAZIONI A: Gestione delle strutture FUNZIONE DI GESTIONE SIGNIFICAnte (SI/NO): No. PRESCRIBILITÀ: N/A TAKER RISCHIO MATERIALE (YES/NO): No. CERTIFICATO (SI/NO): No. CERTIFICATO (SI/NO): N/A L'ultima volta: Giugno 2026 Principali responsabilità Il ruolo Tecnico di Manutenzione Multi-skilled è un membro chiave del team di Strutture il cui ruolo principale è quello di assistere il responsabile degli Impianti nelle operazioni di costruzione e strutture quotidiane, tra cui l'esecuzione di manutenzione generale, portering, disposizione spaziale, mobili (sedie, scrivanie, armadietti, piedistallo e chiave) gestione all'interno dell'edificio di ufficio, monitoraggio della conformità, collegamento con la sicurezza fisica sui passaggi di accesso e supervisione le consegne sicure quando necessario- Role Duties Sicurezza generale BAU
• Sotto la supervisione del responsabile degli impianti, il titolare del dazio sarà responsabile per la manutenzione reattiva minore, PPMs, riarrangiamento dei mobili, riparazioni di attrezzature ad-hoc, e il mantenimento generale del tessuto dell'edificio.
• Per aiutare con qualsiasi manutenzione preventiva reattiva o pianificata che può includere idraulici compiti richiesti in tutto l'ufficio - cioè, cambiando rubinetti, sblocco servizi igienici, modifica perdite, e la sostituzione dei sedili WC, ecc.
• Per svolgere piccoli compiti di manutenzione generale pianificati e non pianificati relativi alle infrastrutture edilizie, impianti meccanici e sistemi di attrezzature e per completare i documenti pertinenti in relazione alle opere sopra descritte.
• Esperienza in scambi multi-qualificati e compiti generali di persona (ad esempio carpenteria, fresatura, serrature cambianti, ecc).
• Per rispondere a qualsiasi richiesta di manutenzione di impianti fatta dal personale in modo tempestivo, efficiente e ad un alto standard.
• Lavorare in collaborazione con altri dipartimenti, in particolare con i team di comunicazione, Catering e IT, nonché con gli stakeholder esterni sulle questioni relative alle strutture, e fornire supporto laddove necessario.
• Per essere disponibile per occasionali chiamate di emergenza fuori dalle normali ore di lavoro per rispondere alle emergenze di manutenzione serate o fine settimana come può richiesto dal responsabile degli impianti.
• Agire nel ruolo di Fire Marshal e far parte del Fire Safety Team durante l'evacuazione di emergenza antincendio.
• Fornire il supporto necessario durante l'evacuazione del fuoco, trapano di fuoco di 6 mesi e test di allarme antincendio settimanale.
• Per completare i controlli periodici delle attività infrastrutturali edilizie e tornare al responsabile degli impianti.
• Monitorare l'accesso e rispondere a avvisi e incidenti di sicurezza o di sicurezza.
• Controllare le consegne e la firma per i pacchetti quando necessario.
• Mantenere le porte di uscita di evacuazione del fuoco liberate da ostruzioni.
• Disposizione degli spazi interni per riunioni ed eventi come richiesto dagli organizzatori o dal responsabile degli impianti.
• Contribuire alla manutenzione dell'edificio segnalando guasti o danni ai raccordi e agli apparecchi , e coordinare con i team di manutenzione esterna per le riparazioni.
• La competenza con i sistemi informatici per la registrazione, il monitoraggio CCTV e altri compiti amministrativi.
• Monitoraggio delle collezioni di rifiuti giornalieri, settimanali o mensili, inclusi rifiuti generali, alimentari, riciclaggio misto, RAEE, sanitari e riservati.
• Utilizzi mensili letture metri – cioè acqua ed elettricità.
• Per svolgere qualsiasi altro dovere all'interno della competenza del titolare del post, come può essere richiesto di volta in volta.
• La descrizione del lavoro non è esaustiva e può includere altri compiti assegnati di volta in volta dalla gestione. Numero di ore di lavoro
• Questa è una posizione unica e il titolare del dovere lavorerà come tecnico di manutenzione multi-skilled.
• L'orario di lavoro è: 0800 – 1700 dal lunedì al venerdì e come può essere richiesto dal business.
• Continuità aziendale
• Lavoro remoto – N/A. Composizione del Comitato
• Nessuno Regole di condotta Questo ruolo è tenuto a rispettare le regole di condotta individuale dell’Autorità di conduzione finanziaria (FCA) che sono:
• agire con integrità;
• agire con la dovuta abilità, cura e diligenza;
• Per essere aperta e cooperativa con la FCA, l'Autorita` del Regolamento prudenziale (PRA) e altri regolatori;
• pagare a causa degli interessi dei clienti e trattarli correttamente;
• osservare gli standard adeguati di condotta di mercato; e
• Per agire per fornire buoni risultati per i clienti al dettaglio. Specificazione della persona Conoscenza, competenze e esperienza
• In grado di spostare oggetti di mobili di oltre 20kg.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e capacità di mantenere atteggiamento positivo e tono professionale tutto il tempo.
• I candidati che hanno lavorato come Assistente di Servizi, Tecnico Edilizia, Coordinatore Immobiliare o General Multi-skilled Technician/Handyperson.
• In grado di rispondere in modo appropriato con il pensiero rapido e il processo decisionale anche quando sono messi sul posto.
• Sorvegliare il mantenimento sicuro delle chiavi dell'edificio per consentire l'accesso per la manutenzione e le riparazioni quando necessario.
• I candidati che hanno lavorato in istituzioni finanziarie, ospitalità o ambiente simile e hanno esperienza di multitasking, mantenendo un atteggiamento professionale e offrendo un servizio clienti eccellente.
• Le persone specificate devono possedere un edificio generale e strutture di formazione che acquisiscono attraverso l'istruzione formale o hands-on, e dovrebbero avere un minimo di passaggi GCSE o equivalente, in particolare in inglese e matematica.
• I candidati che parlano più di una lingua hanno un vantaggio, così come coloro che hanno completato la formazione nella gestione delle strutture, il movimento e la gestione, la salute e la sicurezza o il servizio clienti.
• Competente con strumenti per assistere con problemi locali di base.
• Eccellente capacità interpersonali, per affrontare il personale di tutti i livelli.
• Competenze e Valori Livello richiesto Strutture e focus del cliente 4 Mostra l'unità per eseguire e avere successo 4 Persistente nel seguire e attraverso i problemi 3 Ritiene lo standard legale, normativo ed etico del Gruppo UBP 2 Buona conoscenza del prodotto 1 Conoscenza dei requisiti normativi e industriali 1 Sviluppo aziendale 1 Comunicazione - ascolto, scritto e verbale con i clienti 3 Influenza 1 Conoscenza dei prodotti e dei servizi 1 Costruzione di relazioni - interno ed esterno 3 Sensibilizzazione strategica e commerciale 1 Pianificazione e organizzazione 2 Etica e valori 4 Spiegazione: 1: basso livello di competenza / competenze richieste, 2-3: livello medio di competenza / competenze richieste, 4-5: alto livello di competenza necessaria

Stellenbeschreibung Mehrfacher Wartungstechniker NAME: TITEL FÜR DEN GEMEINSAMEN TITEL: Mehrfacher Wartungstechniker POSITION: Partner BERICHTE AN: Betriebsleiter WESENTLICHE VERWALTUNGSFUNKTION (JA/NEIN): Nein VORBEREITETE VERANTWORTUNG: N/A WESENTLICHER RISIKOBETRAG (JA/NEIN): Nein BESCHEINIGUNG (JA/NEIN): Nein BESCHEINIGUNG (JA/NEIN): N/A LETZTE AKTUALISIERUNG: Juni 2026 Hauptzuständigkeiten Die Rolle des Multi-Skilled Maintenance Technikers ist ein wichtiges Mitglied des Facilities-Teams, dessen Hauptaufgabe darin besteht, den Facilities Manager im täglichen Gebäude- und Anlagenbetrieb zu unterstützen, einschließlich der Durchführung allgemeiner Wartungsarbeiten, Portering, räumlicher Anordnung, des Möbelmanagements (Stühle, Schreibtische, Schließfächer, Sockel & Schlüssel) im Bürogebäude, der Überwachung der Einhaltung, der Verbindung mit der physischen Sicherheit auf Zugangskarten und der Überwachung der Lieferungen bei Bedarf und der Aufrechterhaltung der sicheren Aufbewahrung der Türschlüssel, um den Zugang für Wartung und Reparaturen zu ermöglichen auf einer täglichen Basis. Rollenaufgaben General Security BAU
• Unter der Aufsicht des Facilities Managers ist der Pflichtinhaber für geringfügige reaktive Wartung, PPMs, Möbelumbau, Ad-hoc-Reparaturen und allgemeine Instandhaltung des Gebäudes verantwortlich.
• Zur Unterstützung bei reaktiven oder geplanten vorbeugenden Wartungsarbeiten, die im gesamten Büro erforderliche Sanitärarbeiten umfassen können - z. B. Ändern von Wasserhähnen, ungeblockte Toilette, Ausbessern von Lecks und Ersetzen von Toilettensitzen usw.
• Durchführung von geringfügigen geplanten und ungeplanten allgemeinen Instandhaltungsaufgaben im Zusammenhang mit den Gebäudeinfrastrukturen, mechanischen Anlagen und Ausrüstungssystemen und Abschluss relevanter Unterlagen im Zusammenhang mit den oben genannten Arbeiten.
• Erfahrung in multi-sachkundigen Berufen und allgemeinen handwerklichen Aufgaben (z. B. Schreinerei, Bodenbearbeitung, Schleusenwechsel usw.).
• Um auf alle Wartungsanfragen der Mitarbeiter rechtzeitig, effizient und auf hohem Niveau zu reagieren.
• Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen, insbesondere den Kommunikationsteams, Catering und IT sowie externen Stakeholdern in Anlagenfragen und Unterstützung bei Bedarf.
• Für gelegentliche Notrufe außerhalb der normalen Geschäftszeiten verfügbar zu sein, um auf Wartungsnotfälle abends oder am Wochenende zu reagieren, wie vom Facilities Manager gewünscht.
• In der Rolle des Brandmarschalls zu handeln und Teil des Brandschutzteams während der Noträumung zu sein.
• Bieten Sie die notwendige Unterstützung während der Brandevakuierung, der 6-monatigen Brandschutzübung und der wöchentlichen Brandmeldeprüfung.
• Um regelmäßige Überprüfungen der Gebäudeinfrastrukturanlagen durchzuführen und an den Anlagenmanager zu berichten.
• Überwachung des Zugriffs und Reaktion auf Sicherheits- oder Sicherheitswarnungen und Vorfälle.
• Überwachung der Lieferungen und Unterzeichnung von Paketen bei Bedarf.
• Feuerevakuierungstüren von Hindernissen freihalten.
• Anordnung von internen Räumen für Meetings und Veranstaltungen, wie von den Organisatoren oder dem Facilities Manager verlangt.
• Beitrag zur Instandhaltung des Gebäudes durch Meldung von Fehlern oder Beschädigungen an Armaturen und Vorrichtungen und Koordination mit ausgelagerten Wartungsteams für Reparaturen.
• Kenntnisse mit Computersystemen für die Aufzeichnung, CCTV-Überwachung und andere administrative Aufgaben.
• Überwachung der täglichen, wöchentlichen oder monatlichen Abfallsammlungen, einschließlich allgemeiner Abfälle, Lebensmittel, gemischtes Recycling, Elektro- und Elektronik-Altgeräte, Sanitär- und vertraulicher Abfälle.

Description de l'emploi Technicien de maintenance polyvalent NOM: TITRE DE L'EMPLOI : Technicien de maintenance polyvalent POSITION: Associé RAPPORTS PRÉSENTÉS AU : Gestionnaire des installations FONCTION DE GESTION SIGNIFIANTE (OUI/NO): Numéro RÉPONSABILITÉ PRESCRIBÉE: Sans objet RISQUES (OUI/NO): Numéro CERTIFIÉ (OUI/NO): Numéro CERTIFIÉ (OUI/NO): Sans objet Dernière mise à jour : Juin 2026 Principales responsabilités Le rôle de technicien d'entretien polyvalent est un membre clé de l'équipe des installations dont le rôle principal est d'aider le gestionnaire des installations dans les activités courantes des bâtiments et des installations, y compris l'entretien général, le portage, l'aménagement de l'espace, la gestion du mobilier (chaises, bureaux, casiers, piédestal et clés) dans le bâtiment de bureau, la surveillance de la conformité, la liaison avec la sécurité physique sur les laissez-passer d'accès et la supervision des livraisons, au besoin, et l'entretien sécuritaire des portes. Fonctions Sécurité générale
• Sous la supervision du gestionnaire des installations, le titulaire sera responsable de l'entretien réactif mineur, des PPM, de la réorganisation des meubles, des réparations ad hoc de l'équipement et de l'entretien général du tissu du bâtiment.
• Pour aider à tout entretien préventif réactif ou planifié qui peut inclure des tâches de plomberie requises dans tout le bureau - c.-à-d., changer les robinets, les toilettes débloquées, réparer les fuites, et remplacer les sièges de toilettes, etc.
• S'acquitter de tâches d'entretien générales mineures, planifiées et non planifiées, liées aux infrastructures de construction, aux installations mécaniques et aux systèmes d'équipement, et remplir les documents nécessaires pour les travaux susmentionnés.
• Expérience dans les métiers polyvalents et les tâches d'une personne pratique (p. ex. menuiserie, labour, changement d'écluses, etc.).
• Répondre aux demandes d'entretien des installations faites par le personnel en temps opportun, efficacement et selon des normes élevées.
• Travailler en collaboration avec d'autres ministères, en particulier les équipes de communication, de restauration et de TI, ainsi qu'avec des intervenants externes, sur les questions liées aux installations, et fournir un soutien au besoin.
• Être disponible pour les appels d'urgence occasionnels en dehors des heures normales d'ouverture pour répondre aux urgences d'entretien les soirs ou les week-ends, selon la demande du gestionnaire des installations.
• Faire partie de l'équipe de la sécurité incendie pendant l'évacuation d'urgence.
• Fournir le soutien nécessaire lors de l'évacuation des incendies, des exercices d'incendie semestriels et des essais hebdomadaires d'alarme incendie.
• Effectuer des vérifications périodiques des infrastructures du bâtiment et en rendre compte au gestionnaire des installations.
• Surveiller l'accès et répondre aux alertes et aux incidents de sécurité.
• Superviser les livraisons et signer les colis au besoin.
• Garder les portes de sortie d'évacuation d'incendie dégagées des obstacles.
• Aménagement des espaces internes pour les réunions et les événements requis par les organisateurs ou le gestionnaire des installations.
• Contribuer à l'entretien du bâtiment en signalant les défauts ou les dommages aux accessoires et aux installations, et coordonner avec les équipes d'entretien externalisées pour les réparations.
• Connaissance des systèmes informatiques pour la tenue des dossiers, la surveillance de la vidéosurveillance et d'autres tâches administratives.
• Surveillance des collectes quotidiennes, hebdomadaires ou mensuelles de déchets, y compris les déchets généraux, alimentaires, de recyclage mixte, de DEEE, sanitaires et confidentiels.
• Lectures mensuelles des compteurs de services publics – c.-à-d., eau et électricité.
• Entreprendre toute autre tâche relevant de la compétence du titulaire du poste, selon les besoins.
• La description de travail n'est pas exhaustive et peut inclure d'autres tâches assignées de temps à autre par la direction . Nombre d'heures de poste et de travail
• Il s'agit d'un seul poste et le titulaire travaillera comme technicien de maintenance polyvalent.
• Les heures de travail sont: 0800 – 1700 du lundi au vendredi et selon les besoins de l'entreprise.
• Continuité des activités
• Travail à distance – S.O. Composition du Comité
• Aucune Règles de conduite Ce rôle est requis pour se conformer aux règles de conduite individuelle de l'Autorité de conduite financière (AFC), qui sont les suivantes :
• Agir avec intégrité;
• Agir avec compétence, diligence et diligence;
• être ouvert et coopérer avec la FCA, l'autorité de réglementation prudentielle (APR) et d'autres organismes de réglementation;
• De tenir dûment compte des intérêts des clients et de les traiter équitablement;
• Respecter les normes de conduite du marché;
• Agir pour obtenir de bons résultats pour les clients de détail. Spécification de la personne Connaissances, compétences et expérience
• Capable de déplacer des meubles de plus de 20 kg.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité à maintenir une attitude positive et un ton professionnel tout le temps.
• Les candidats qui ont travaillé à titre d'adjoint aux installations, de technicien en bâtiment, de coordonnateur des successions ou de technicien/homme polyvalent général.
• Capable de réagir de façon appropriée en réfléchissant rapidement et en prenant des décisions, même lorsqu'elles sont mises sur place.
• Superviser la conservation en toute sécurité des clés du bâtiment afin de permettre l'accès pour l'entretien et les réparations si nécessaire.
• Les candidats qui ont travaillé dans des institutions financières, l'hospitalité ou un environnement similaire et ont une expérience de multitâche, de maintien d'une attitude professionnelle et de prestation d'un excellent service à la clientèle.
• Les personnes désignées doivent posséder un bâtiment général et des installations de formation qui leur permettent d'acquérir une formation formelle ou pratique, et doivent avoir un minimum de laissez-passer GCSE ou un équivalent, en particulier en anglais et en mathématiques.
• Les candidats qui parlent plus d'une langue ont un avantage, tout comme ceux qui ont suivi une formation en gestion des installations, en déménagement et en manutention, en santé et sécurité ou en service à la clientèle.
• Compétence en outils pour aider à résoudre les problèmes de base liés aux locaux.
• Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, pour traiter avec le personnel de tous les niveaux.

jobs.title: System Engineer - Active Directory Specialist
jobs.description:
• Mission:

• As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a crucial role in managing and improving our Microsoft/Citrix based systems and infrastructure. Your expertise will be essential in ensuring high availability, performance, and security of our IT services.

• Challenges:

• Evolve in a challenging, regulated environment for a fast and growing Private Bank

• Main responsibilities:

• Design, implementation, and management of Microsoft-related technologies, including but not limited to Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Exchange, Microsoft PKI, DFS, MS Teams.

• Troubleshoot and improve AD replication, DNS, and Group Policy Objects (GPOs).

• Implement and enforce security policies, including password policies, account lockout policies, and auditing.

• Integrate Active Directory with other systems, such as Office 365, Azure AD, and third-party applications.

• Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts for automation of routine tasks and reporting

• Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans for Active Directory.

• Setting up and maintaining Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities.

• Design, implementation, and management of Citrix-related technologies,

• Provide production support for our Microsoft environments, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

• Manage and resolve complex incidents and problems, minimizing downtime and mitigating impacts on business operations.

• Implement and maintain system monitoring solutions to pre-emptively identify potential issues (SCOM / NIMSOFT).

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams for system enhancements and integration of new technologies.

• Ensure compliance with security policies and procedures, including regular system audits and updates.

• Conduct root cause analysis for major incidents and lead problem management processes.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.

• Be part of an on-call service rotation one week per month (24/24-7j/7)

• Must have with strong expertise in:

• Microsoft Infra (AD, DHCP, SCOM)

• PKI and certificat management

• SCCM

• Exchange 2019

• Powershell scripting

• MS Teams

• Ansible

• Nice to have :

• M365

• Citrix

• AirWatch MDM Mobility plateform

• Intune

• Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Junior Institutional Sales Iberia/Latam (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
About UBP Asset Management
 UBP Asset Management is an international investment manager with expertise across traditional and alternative asset classes. The Iberia & LATAM team develops long-term relationships with institutional investors, private banks, wealth managers and family offices throughout the region.

Joining UBP offers the opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial and international environment while building a long-term career in asset management distribution.
 About the Role
 We are looking for a motivated and ambitious Junior Sales professional to join the Iberia & LATAM Distribution team in Madrid.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional (3–8 years of experience) who is passionate about financial markets and asset management and wants to develop a career in institutional and wholesale sales.

The successful candidate will support the sales team in developing relationships with institutional investors, private banks, wealth managers, distributors and family offices across Iberia and Latin America. The role offers significant exposure to client interactions, investment products, and international collaboration within UBP's Asset Management business.
 Key Responsibilities
 Business Development & Sales Support
 • Support the sales team in developing and maintaining relationships with institutional clients, private banks, wealth managers, family offices and other distribution partners across Iberia and LATAM.
 • Assist in identifying new business opportunities and contribute to client acquisition initiatives.
 • Prepare client presentations, marketing materials, meeting agendas and follow-up documentation.
 • Coordinate client meetings, roadshows and industry events.
 • Maintain CRM records and sales pipelines, ensuring accurate reporting of client activity.
 • Support responses to RFIs, RFPs and due diligence questionnaires.

Client Relationship Management
 • Build strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
 • Deliver a high standard of client service.
 • Work closely with Investment Specialists, Product Specialists, Marketing, Operations and Client Services.
 • Participate in client meetings alongside senior sales colleagues and progressively take ownership of selected relationships.

Market Intelligence
 • Monitor market trends, competitor activity and industry developments.
 • Assist in identifying sales opportunities and new market segments.
 • Contribute ideas to improve sales initiatives and client engagement.
 Experience & Requirements
 Essential Experience
 • 3–8 years of experience in Asset Management, Private Banking, Wealth Management or Financial Services.
 • Previous experience in sales support, business development, client relationship management or distribution is preferred.
 • Strong interest in investment markets and asset management.
 • Good understanding of investment products including mutual funds, fixed income, equities and multi-asset solutions.
 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
 • Strong analytical, organisational and Microsoft Office skills.

Education
 • Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or related discipline.
 • CFA or CAIA progress is an advantage.

Languages
 • Fluent Spanish and professional English.
 • Portuguese is a strong advantage.
 Personal Attributes
 • Commercial mindset with a genuine interest in business development.
 • Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
 • Self-motivated and proactive.
 • Strong team player.
 • Curious about financial markets.
 • Professional presence and high ethical standards.

descriptionByLocale.en:
About UBP Asset Management
UBP Asset Management is an international investment manager with expertise across traditional and alternative asset classes. The Iberia & LATAM team develops long-term relationships with institutional investors, private banks, wealth managers and family offices throughout the region.

Joining UBP offers the opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial and international environment while building a long-term career in asset management distribution.
About the Role
We are looking for a motivated and ambitious Junior Sales professional to join the Iberia & LATAM Distribution team in Madrid.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional (3–8 years of experience) who is passionate about financial markets and asset management and wants to develop a career in institutional and wholesale sales.

The successful candidate will support the sales team in developing relationships with institutional investors, private banks, wealth managers, distributors and family offices across Iberia and Latin America. The role offers significant exposure to client interactions, investment products, and international collaboration within UBP's Asset Management business.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development & Sales Support
• Support the sales team in developing and maintaining relationships with institutional clients, private banks, wealth managers, family offices and other distribution partners across Iberia and LATAM.
• Assist in identifying new business opportunities and contribute to client acquisition initiatives.
• Prepare client presentations, marketing materials, meeting agendas and follow-up documentation.
• Coordinate client meetings, roadshows and industry events.
• Maintain CRM records and sales pipelines, ensuring accurate reporting of client activity.
• Support responses to RFIs, RFPs and due diligence questionnaires.

Client Relationship Management
• Build strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
• Deliver a high standard of client service.
• Work closely with Investment Specialists, Product Specialists, Marketing, Operations and Client Services.
• Participate in client meetings alongside senior sales colleagues and progressively take ownership of selected relationships.

Market Intelligence
• Monitor market trends, competitor activity and industry developments.
• Assist in identifying sales opportunities and new market segments.
• Contribute ideas to improve sales initiatives and client engagement.
Experience & Requirements
Essential Experience
• 3–8 years of experience in Asset Management, Private Banking, Wealth Management or Financial Services.
• Previous experience in sales support, business development, client relationship management or distribution is preferred.
• Strong interest in investment markets and asset management.
• Good understanding of investment products including mutual funds, fixed income, equities and multi-asset solutions.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Strong analytical, organisational and Microsoft Office skills.

Education
• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or related discipline.
• CFA or CAIA progress is an advantage.

Languages
• Fluent Spanish and professional English.
• Portuguese is a strong advantage.
Personal Attributes
• Commercial mindset with a genuine interest in business development.
• Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
• Self-motivated and proactive.
• Strong team player.
• Curious about financial markets.
• Professional presence and high ethical standards.

jobs.description:
Mission
 As a Wealth Management Assistant, you will play a vital role in our organization, offering administrative and operational support to our Senior Relationship Managers. Your work will directly contribute to the success of our wealth management division, ensuring smooth operations and exceptional client experiences. By joining our team, you'll be part of a dynamic and collaborative environment, working closely with experienced professionals to deliver the highest standards of service.

Main responsibilities
 Administrative support to Relationship Managers:

• Prepare and organize client‑meeting packs, presentations, and briefing notes.

• Monitor account‑opening processes end‑to‑end, coordinating outstanding items and approvals.

• Collect, validate, and maintain KYC/CDD documentation; track renewals and trigger periodic reviews.

• Update CRM/client records and ensure documentation is audit‑ready.

Transaction and operations execution:

• Follow up and process client cash movements, stock market orders, deposits, loan instructions... in an accurate and prompt manner.

• Coordinate with Operations, Compliance, and Front Office to ensure timely settlement and issue resolution.

• Apply regulatory requirements and internal procedures; escalate exceptions and maintain proper controls.

• Reconcile transactions and maintain logs/SOPs for audit and MI reporting.

Client service and inquiry management:

• Serve as a primary contact for day‑to‑day queries; provide quick, clear updates on requests and cases.

• Proactively communicate status on onboarding, KYC, and transaction execution.

• Identify and address service gaps; contribute to continuous improvement of client experience.

• Uphold high service levels (SLAs, TATs, and quality metrics).

Your profile

• Higher education in Banking, Finance or Wealth Management.

• A previous experience, of 3-5 years, in WM (front-office and facing clients) is required.

• Committed team player with good capacities of working autonomously.

• Client focused with a deep sense of discretion/confidentiality and problem-solving attitude.

• Excellent communication capabilities.

• Being bilingual in English and Portuguese is a must. Knowledge of French is an important asset.

• Good knowledge of Administrative IT tools [MS Office].

By joining Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A in Lisbon you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility.
 Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A. encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neuro diversity.
 In accordance with the current regulations, the retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.

En vous joignant à notre équipe, vous ferez partie d'un environnement dynamique et collaboratif, travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des professionnels expérimentés pour offrir les plus hautes normes de service. Principales responsabilités Soutien administratif aux gestionnaires de relations :
• Préparer et organiser des trousses de réunions, des présentations et des notes d'information.
• Surveiller les processus d'ouverture de compte de bout en bout, coordonner les éléments en suspens et les approbations.
• Recueillir, valider et tenir à jour la documentation sur les CYK/CDD; suivre les renouvellements et déclencher des examens périodiques.
• Mettre à jour les dossiers CRM/client et s'assurer que la documentation est prête à être vérifiée. Exécution des transactions et opérations:
• Suivre et traiter les mouvements de trésorerie des clients, les ordres boursiers, les dépôts, les instructions de prêt... de manière précise et rapide.
• Coordonner avec les Opérations, la Conformité et le Front Office afin d'assurer un règlement et un règlement en temps opportun.
• Appliquer les exigences réglementaires et les procédures internes; intensifier les exceptions et maintenir les contrôles appropriés.
• Reconcile les transactions et tient à jour les registres et les PON pour les rapports de vérification et de GI. Services à la clientèle et gestion des demandes de renseignements :
• Servir de contact principal pour les demandes quotidiennes; fournir des mises à jour rapides et claires sur les demandes et les cas.
• Communiquer proactivement le statut à bord, KYC et l'exécution de la transaction.
• Identifier et combler les lacunes en matière de services; contribuer à l'amélioration continue de l'expérience des clients.
• Maintenir des niveaux de service élevés (SLA, TAT et métriques de qualité). Votre profil
• Enseignement supérieur en banque, finance ou gestion de patrimoine.
• Une expérience antérieure, de 3 à 5 ans, en WM (avant-poste et clients faisant face) est requise.
• Joueur d'équipe engagé avec de bonnes capacités de travail autonome.
• Le client s'est concentré sur un sentiment profond de discrétion/confidentialité et d'attitude de résolution de problèmes.
• Excellentes capacités de communication.
• Être bilingue en anglais et en portugais est un must. La connaissance du français est un atout important.
• Bonne connaissance des outils informatiques administratifs [Bureau du SM]. En rejoignant l'Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A à Lisbonne, vous allez embrasser une équipe de professionnels hautement qualifiés en banque privée qui vous mènera à développer votre carrière au plus haut niveau. Nous encourageons l'apprentissage continu, le développement et le partage des connaissances. Nous favorisons une culture de l'agilité, de la condamnation, de la dédicace et du haut degré de responsabilité. Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A. encourage tous les candidats qualifiés et admissibles à présenter une demande quelle que soit leur identité ou expression de genre, leur âge, leur origine raciale, ethnique et culturelle, leur religion et leurs croyances, leur orientation sexuelle, leur handicap ou leur neurodiversité. Conformément à la réglementation actuelle, le candidat retenu sera tenu de fournir un extrait de son casier judiciaire dans le cadre du processus de présélection du PPU.

titleByLocale.it: Compliance Officer Sanzioni & Corporate Due Diligence

titleByLocale.de: Compliance Officer Sanktionen & Corporate Due Diligence
titleByLocale.fr: Compliance Officer Sanctions & Corporate Due Diligence

jobs.description:
• Mission
• Support the Group Head of Sanctions & Corporate due diligence in the development and implementation of a strong control framework for corporate & shipping accounts.

• Participate in projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing the bank's overall sanctions framework.

• Assist Group Sanctions and Corporate due diligence teams in their daily tasks (due diligence on new and existing clients, ad-hoc reviews and monitoring of specific transactions).

• Main responsibilities
• Participate actively to Bank’s projects related to the global sanctions’ framework.

• Perform in-depth reviews of commercial accounts from an AML, Tax and Sanction perspective.

• Ensure compliance with international sanctions programs at UBP Group level by preparing work instructions/ guidance, ensuring and developing suitable tools and processes.

• Perform periodic assessments of specific Group clients, products and/or services to identify any sanctions risks and take corrective actions if appropriate.

• Ensure the Sanction’s watch including mainly SECO, EU and OFAC regimes for UBP Group.

• Assess the impacts of new sanctions regimes across UBP Group and coordinate with other departments/ stakeholders as required.

• Assist and advice transaction monitoring teams for any question related to sanctions and commercial accounts.

• Participate to maintenance and configuration projects/initiatives of Group sanctions tools.

• Investigate and report suspicious transactions to the relevant authorities, ensuring compliance with AML (Anti-Money Laundering) and sanctions regulations.

• Provide day-to-day advice to colleagues in Compliance, BRMs and Front Office on the internal framework related to commercial accounts.

• Participation in reviewing the internal regulatory framework governing the monitoring of transactional activities of commercial accounts.

• Support the Group’s entities in reviewing commercial accounts opened in their books.

• Your Profile
• Master's degree.

• Professional certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist/Sanctions Specialist) or CAS in Financial Services are preferred.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in AML, Sanctions, Tax or compliance within the financial services industry, ideally in universal banks.

• Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements related to AML & Sanctions, including specificities linked to shipping and trade finance industries.

• Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex regulatory issues to various stakeholders.

• Work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Missione
• Sostenere il Capo Gruppo di Sanzioni & Corporate due diligence nello sviluppo e nell'attuazione di un quadro di controllo forte per conti aziendali e di spedizione.
• Partecipano a progetti e iniziative volte a migliorare il quadro generale delle sanzioni della banca.
• Assist Group Sanctions and Corporate due diligence team nelle loro attività quotidiane (due diligence su clienti nuovi e esistenti, recensioni ad-hoc e monitoraggio di transazioni specifiche).
• Principali responsabilità
• Partecipa attivamente ai progetti della Banca relativi al quadro delle sanzioni globali.
• Esegui recensioni approfondite di conti commerciali da una prospettiva AML, Tax e Sanction.
• Assicurare il rispetto dei programmi di sanzioni internazionali a livello del Gruppo UBP preparando istruzioni/guida di lavoro, garantendo e sviluppando strumenti e processi adeguati.
• Eseguire valutazioni periodiche di specifici clienti, prodotti e/o servizi del Gruppo per identificare eventuali rischi di sanzioni e intraprendere azioni correttive se del caso.
• Assicurare l’orologio della Sanzione, tra cui principalmente i regimi SECO, EU e OFAC per il Gruppo UBP.
• Valutare l'impatto di nuovi regimi di sanzioni in tutto il Gruppo UBP e coordinare con altri dipartimenti / stakeholder come richiesto.
• Assistere e consigliare i team di monitoraggio delle transazioni per qualsiasi domanda relativa a sanzioni e conti commerciali.
• Partecipazione a progetti di manutenzione e configurazione/iniziativa di strumenti di sanzioni di Gruppo.
• Indagare e segnalare transazioni sospette alle autorità competenti, assicurando il rispetto delle norme AML (Anti-Money Laundering) e sanzioni.
• Fornisci consulenza quotidiana ai colleghi in conformità, BRM e Front Office sul quadro interno relativo ai conti commerciali.
• Partecipazione alla revisione del quadro normativo interno che disciplina il monitoraggio delle attività transazionali dei conti commerciali.
• Sostenere le entità del Gruppo nella revisione dei conti commerciali aperti nei loro libri.
• Il tuo profilo
• Laurea magistrale.
• Sono preferiti certificazioni professionali come CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist/Sanctions Specialist) o CAS in Financial Services.
• Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza in AML, sanzioni, tasse o conformità all'interno del settore dei servizi finanziari, idealmente in banche universali.
• Forte conoscenza dei requisiti normativi relativi a AML & Sanctions, comprese le specificità legate alle industrie di trasporto e finanza commerciale.
• Eccellente capacità analitiche e attenzione ai dettagli.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di articolare complesse questioni regolamentari a vari stakeholder.
• Lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di un team in un ambiente frenetico. Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

descriptionByLocale.de:
• Mission
• Unterstützen Sie den Group Head of Sanctions & Corporate Due Diligence bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung eines starken Kontrollrahmens für Corporate & Shipping Accounts.
• Teilnahme an Projekten und Initiativen zur Verbesserung des allgemeinen Sanktionsrahmens der Bank.
• Unterstützung von Gruppensanktionen und Corporate Due Diligence Teams bei ihren täglichen Aufgaben (Due Diligence bei neuen und bestehenden Kunden, Ad-hoc-Bewertungen und Überwachung bestimmter Transaktionen).
• Hauptzuständigkeiten
• Beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an Projekten der Bank im Zusammenhang mit dem globalen Sanktionsrahmen.
• Führen Sie eingehende Überprüfungen der kommerziellen Konten aus einer AML-, Steuer- und Sanktionsperspektive durch.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung internationaler Sanktionsprogramme auf Ebene der UBP-Gruppe durch die Erstellung von Arbeitsanweisungen und Anleitungen sowie durch die Sicherstellung und Entwicklung geeigneter Werkzeuge und Prozesse.
• Führen Sie regelmäßige Bewertungen bestimmter Kunden, Produkte und/oder Dienstleistungen der Gruppe durch, um etwaige Sanktionsrisiken zu identifizieren, und ergreifen Sie gegebenenfalls Korrekturmaßnahmen.
• Gewährleistung der Überwachung der Sanktion, einschließlich der Systeme SECO, EU und OFAC für die UBP Group.
• Beurteilen Sie die Auswirkungen neuer Sanktionsregelungen in der UBP-Gruppe und stimmen Sie sich bei Bedarf mit anderen Abteilungen/Stakeholdern ab.
• Unterstützung und Beratung von Transaktionsüberwachungsteams bei Fragen zu Sanktionen und Geschäftskonten.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an Wartungs- und Konfigurationsprojekten / -initiativen von Sanktionsinstrumenten für Gruppen.
• Untersuchung und Meldung verdächtiger Transaktionen an die zuständigen Behörden, um die Einhaltung der Vorschriften zur Bekämpfung der Geldwäsche (AML) und Sanktionen zu gewährleisten.
• Tägliche Beratung von Kollegen in Compliance, BRMs und Front Office zum internen Rahmen für kommerzielle Konten.
• Beteiligung an der Überprüfung des internen Rechtsrahmens für die Überwachung der Transaktionstätigkeiten von Geschäftskonten.
• Unterstützen Sie die Unternehmen der Gruppe bei der Überprüfung von Geschäftskonten, die in ihren Büchern eröffnet wurden.
• Ihr Profil
• Master-Abschluss.
• Professionelle Zertifizierungen wie CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist/Sanctions Specialist) oder CAS in Financial Services werden bevorzugt.
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in AML, Sanktionen, Steuern oder Compliance in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche, idealerweise in Universalbanken.
• Kenntnis der regulatorischen Anforderungen im Zusammenhang mit AML und Sanktionen, einschließlich der Besonderheiten im Zusammenhang mit der Schifffahrts- und Handelsfinanzbranche.
• Ausgezeichnete analytische Fähigkeiten und Liebe zum Detail.
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe regulatorische Fragen an verschiedene Interessengruppen zu artikulieren.
• Arbeiten Sie unabhängig und als Teil eines Teams in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung. Kernkompetenzen : Einhaltung der Werte des Unternehmens: Hingabe, Überzeugung, Agilität und Verantwortung - Einhaltung von Vorschriften und internen Richtlinien
descriptionByLocale.fr:
• Mission
• Soutenir le chef du groupe Sanctions & Corporate due diligence dans l'élaboration et la mise en œuvre d'un cadre de contrôle solide pour les comptes d'entreprise & maritime.
• Participer à des projets et à des initiatives visant à améliorer le cadre général de sanctions de la banque.
• Aider les équipes de sanctions collectives et de diligence raisonnable des entreprises dans leurs tâches quotidiennes (diligence raisonnable sur les clients nouveaux et existants, examen ad hoc et suivi de certaines transactions).
• Principales responsabilités
• Participer activement aux projets de la Banque relatifs au cadre des sanctions mondiales.
• Effectuer des examens approfondis des comptes commerciaux sous l'angle de la LMA, de la fiscalité et de la sanction.
• Assurer le respect des programmes de sanctions internationales au niveau du groupe UBP en préparant des instructions et des directives de travail, en assurant et en élaborant des outils et des processus appropriés.
• Effectuer des évaluations périodiques de clients, de produits et/ou de services spécifiques du Groupe afin de déterminer les risques de sanctions et de prendre des mesures correctives, le cas échéant.
• Assurer la surveillance des Sanctions, y compris principalement les régimes SECO, EU et OFAC pour UBP Group.
• Évaluer les répercussions des nouveaux régimes de sanctions dans l'ensemble du groupe PPU et coordonner au besoin avec les autres ministères et intervenants.
• Aider et conseiller les équipes de surveillance des transactions pour toute question relative aux sanctions et aux comptes commerciaux.
• Participer aux projets/initiatives de maintenance et de configuration des outils de sanctions du Groupe.
• Enquêter sur les transactions suspectes et les signaler aux autorités compétentes, en veillant au respect de la législation antiblanchiment et des sanctions.
• Fournir des conseils quotidiens aux collègues en matière de conformité, de GRP et de Front Office sur le cadre interne relatif aux comptes commerciaux.
• Participation à l'examen du cadre réglementaire interne régissant le suivi des activités transactionnelles des comptes commerciaux.
• Aider les entités du Groupe à examiner les comptes commerciaux ouverts dans leurs livres.
• Votre profil
• Maîtrise.
• Les certifications professionnelles telles que CAMS (Certified anti-blanchiment Specialist/Sanctions Specialist) ou CAS in Financial Services sont préférées.
• Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en LAM, Sanctions, Fiscalité ou respect dans le secteur des services financiers, idéalement dans les banques universelles.
• Connaissance approfondie des exigences réglementaires liées à la LAM et aux sanctions, y compris les spécificités liées aux industries du transport maritime et du financement du commerce.
• Excellentes compétences analytiques et attention aux détails.
• Fortes compétences en communication, avec la capacité d'articuler des enjeux réglementaires complexes avec divers intervenants.
• Travaillez de façon indépendante et en équipe dans un environnement rapide. Compétences de base : Adhérence aux valeurs de l'entreprise : Dédicace, Conviction, Agilité et Responsabilité - Respect des règlements et des directives internes

jobs.title: Microsoft Cloud Engineer - Consultant
jobs.description:
Function purpose

We are seeking a Cloud Engineer specializing in Microsoft 365 and Modern Workplace solutions, with a strong background in leading or supporting on-premises to cloud transformations. In this role, you will drive the migration, implementation, and optimization of cloud-based solutions, ensuring seamless adoption of M365 and modern workplace technologies. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to modernize our IT infrastructure, enhance productivity, and improve security.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Transformation and Migration

• Lead or contribute to on-premises to cloud migration projects, including email, collaboration tools, identity management, and endpoint management.

• Plan, execute, and validate migrations from on-premises Exchange, SharePoint, and Active Directory to Microsoft 365 and Azure AD.

• Assess and mitigate risks during migration, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.

M365 Administration and Optimization

• Administer and optimize Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and Power Platform and others SaaS services.

• Configure and manage Azure Active Directory (Azure AD), including identity and access management (IAM), conditional access policies, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).

• Automate workflows and processes using PowerShell, Power Automate.

Modern Workplace Solutions

• Deploy and manage modern workplace solutions, including Windows 10/11, Intune, Autopilot, Microsoft Endpoint Manager and Workspace One.

• Implement and support internal and external collaboration tools like Microsoft Teams and SharePoint Online.

• Ensure compliance with security and governance policies for endpoints and cloud services with Purview, Intune.

Security and Compliance

• Monitor and enforce security best practices for M365 and cloud environments.

• Conduct regular audits and implement security controls to protect data and user identities.

• Collaborate with the security team to mitigate risks and respond to incidents.

User Support and Training

• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for M365 and modern workplace issues.

• Develop and deliver training programs to promote user adoption and best practices.

• Create documentation for processes, configurations, and user guides.

Collaboration and Innovation

• Work with stakeholders to identify opportunities for improving productivity and collaboration.

• Evaluate and recommend new M365 features and third-party integrations.

• Stay updated on industry trends and actor’s roadmap for cloud and workplace technologies.

Qualifications and Skills

• 3+ years of experience in administering and supporting Microsoft 365 and modern workplace technologies.

• Proven experience in leading or contributing to on-premises to cloud migration projects (e.g., Exchange to Exchange Online, SharePoint on-prem to SharePoint Online, AD to Azure AD, on-prem to on cloud configuration management with Intune).

• Strong knowledge of Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Power automate.

• Experience with PowerShell scripting for automation and administration.

• Familiarity with Windows 10/11 deployment, management, and security.

• Understanding of security best practices (CIS Framework) and identity protection, data governance and compliance (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001).

• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred

• Microsoft certifications

• Experience with Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Purview, and Sentinel.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Function purpose

We are seeking a Cloud Engineer specializing in Microsoft 365 and Modern Workplace solutions, with a strong background in leading or supporting on-premises to cloud transformations. In this role, you will drive the migration, implementation, and optimization of cloud-based solutions, ensuring seamless adoption of M365 and modern workplace technologies. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to modernize our IT infrastructure, enhance productivity, and improve security.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Transformation and Migration

• Lead or contribute to on-premises to cloud migration projects, including email, collaboration tools, identity management, and endpoint management.

• Plan, execute, and validate migrations from on-premises Exchange, SharePoint, and Active Directory to Microsoft 365 and Azure AD.

• Assess and mitigate risks during migration, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.

M365 Administration and Optimization

• Administer and optimize Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and Power Platform and others SaaS services.

• Configure and manage Azure Active Directory (Azure AD), including identity and access management (IAM), conditional access policies, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).

• Automate workflows and processes using PowerShell, Power Automate.

Modern Workplace Solutions

• Deploy and manage modern workplace solutions, including Windows 10/11, Intune, Autopilot, Microsoft Endpoint Manager and Workspace One.

• Implement and support internal and external collaboration tools like Microsoft Teams and SharePoint Online.

• Ensure compliance with security and governance policies for endpoints and cloud services with Purview, Intune.

Security and Compliance

• Monitor and enforce security best practices for M365 and cloud environments.

• Conduct regular audits and implement security controls to protect data and user identities.

• Collaborate with the security team to mitigate risks and respond to incidents.

User Support and Training

• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for M365 and modern workplace issues.

• Develop and deliver training programs to promote user adoption and best practices.

• Create documentation for processes, configurations, and user guides.

Collaboration and Innovation

• Work with stakeholders to identify opportunities for improving productivity and collaboration.

• Evaluate and recommend new M365 features and third-party integrations.

• Stay updated on industry trends and actor’s roadmap for cloud and workplace technologies.

Qualifications and Skills

• 3+ years of experience in administering and supporting Microsoft 365 and modern workplace technologies.

• Proven experience in leading or contributing to on-premises to cloud migration projects (e.g., Exchange to Exchange Online, SharePoint on-prem to SharePoint Online, AD to Azure AD, on-prem to on cloud configuration management with Intune).

• Strong knowledge of Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Power automate.

• Experience with PowerShell scripting for automation and administration.

• Familiarity with Windows 10/11 deployment, management, and security.

• Understanding of security best practices (CIS Framework) and identity protection, data governance and compliance (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001).

• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred

• Microsoft certifications

• Experience with Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Purview, and Sentinel.

• Knowledge of hybrid cloud environments (Azure, on-premises AD, and M365 integration).

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.description:
As a member of the Client Documentation Team , the Client Documentation Specialist plays a key
role in ensuring:
• A smooth end‑to‑end document process flow across the bank’s departments, especially in
cases of changes in circumstances
• The quality, coherence, and accuracy of client data across the bank’s systems
• The relevance and validity of client instructions by performing signature control
• Efficient and responsive support to other bank departments and branches

Responsibilities:
 Day-to-Day Operations
 - Review client-provided documentation for changes in circumstances or account closures,
ensuring compliance with local and international regulations (e.g., CDB20, CRS, FATCA/QI) and
internal directives and procedures:
 o Formal checks: correct document versions, all mandatory fields completed, required
 signatures present
 o Consistency checks: alignment of data across IDs, corporate documents and bank forms
 - Verify that data entered by Wealth Management Teams in the bank’s systems is complete and
consistent with the signed documentation
 - Perform four-eyes checks and periodic internal controls to ensure procedural adherence and
control quality
Provide high-quality service to Wealth Management Teams by:
 o delivering clear, accurate feedback on errors or missing documents
 o Responding promptly and professionally to queries related to your scope

Coordination & Stakeholder Management
 - Act as a bridge between the Client Documentation Team and key stakeholders (Legal,
Compliance, IT, Wealth Management), maintaining an efficient and consistent communication
flow
 - Serve as a business partner by contributing expertise and practical guidance on:
 o Complex client documentation cases
 o Implementation of new regulations or internal decisions
 o Departmental or bank-wide projects impacting documentation processes
- Coordinate cross-functional efforts to streamline processes and continuously seek
improvements
- Foster a collaborative environment built on trust, open communication and cohesive team
effort; facilitate problem solving across Teams

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) required

• Relevant work experience in a similar role in the finance industry is required

• Proficiency with Microsoft tools, particularly Excel

• Excellent English skills required; German, Italian, French, or another additional language is a
strong plus

• Client-service mindset, intellectual curiosity, and excellent interpersonal skills

Due to the responsibilities of the role, remote/home office work is unfortunately not possible.
Start: asap
Location: Zurich

jobs.description:
• Mission
 We are seeking an experienced and highly autonomous professional to join the Operations team. The role consists in reviewing, optimizing and transforming operational processes across the department.
 This position requires a strong Operational background, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to drive efficiency initiatives.
 The role requires close collaboration with Operations teams, management, IT and other stakeholders to identify improvement opportunities, streamline workflows and support strategic transformation projects.

• Main responsibilities

• Conduct comprehensive reviews of existing operational processes and workflows across the department

• Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, operational risks, and opportunities for automation and optimization

• Design and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, service quality and operational control

• Lead and coordinate transformation initiatives from analysis through implementation

• Facilitate workshops and interviews with stakeholders to gather requirements and understand operational challenges

• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPI to measure process effectiveness and improvements outcomes

• Support change management activities and ensure successful adoption of new processes and operating models

• Ensure that proposed changes comply with regulatory framework, internal policies and risk management

• Document processes, procedures and target operating models

• Your Profile

• Master’s degree in finance or Information Technology

• Minimum 10 years of experience in Banking Operations

• Proven experience in process review, process re-engineering or continuous improvement initiatives

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously

• Strong communication and stakeholders management skills across all organisational levels

• Ability to work independently and challenge the status quo constructively

• Experience with Lean, Six Sigma; Business Process Management or similar methodologies is a strong advantage

• Fluent in French and English; any other language would be a plus

• Excellent knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite especially Excel, programming skills is a plus

• Strong critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills

• Team player

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Microsoft Cloud & Digital Workplace Architect
jobs.description:
• Mission
 Function purpose: The Microsoft Cloud & Digital Workplace Architect is responsible for defining, designing, and leading the implementation of enterprise cloud and workplace solutions across Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365. This strategic and technical leadership role combines Cloud Architecture, Modern Workplace, Security, Identity, Collaboration, and Infrastructure expertise to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and user-centric digital services.
The Architect leads the cloud committee which represent an authority of approval for new cloud service adoption and deployment within the group

• Main responsibilities

Cloud Strategy & Architecture
• Define and maintain the enterprise Microsoft Cloud strategy and roadmap.
• Design secure, scalable, highly available, and cost-effective cloud architectures.
• Ensure cloud solutions align with business objectives, security requirements, and compliance standards.
• Establish Azure Landing Zones and cloud governance models.
 Digital Workplace Architecture
• Define the Digital Workplace vision and architecture.
• Design collaboration and productivity platforms using Microsoft 365.
• Lead workplace transformation initiatives supporting hybrid and remote work.
• Improve employee productivity and digital experience through innovative workplace services.
 Identity, Security & Compliance
• Architect enterprise identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID.
• Define and implement Zero Trust security principles.
• Design Conditional Access, Identity Governance, MFA, and Privileged Access Management.
• Establish security controls mastering: Microsoft Defender Suite, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Information Protection.
 Ensure compliance with industry regulations and corporate policies.
 Endpoint & Device Management
• Define modern endpoint management strategy.
• Lead Microsoft Intune initiative.
• Implement: Windows Autopilot, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Mobile Application Management (MAM), Endpoint Security, Device Compliance Policies
 Technical Leadership
• Act as the senior technical authority for Cloud and Workplace technologies.
• Lead architecture review boards and technical governance committees.
• Define engineering standards and best practices.
• Serve as escalation point for critical technical issues.

• Your Profile

• Qualifications and Skills
• 10+ years of IT Infrastructure, Cloud, and Workplace Services experience.
• 5+ years designing Azure cloud solutions.
• 5+ years architecting Microsoft 365 enterprise environments.
• Proven leadership of digital transformation and cloud migration programs.
• Experience managing enterprise-scale cloud and workplace platforms.
• Strong background in security, compliance, and identity management.

• Required Technical Skills
• Cloud Technologies: Microsoft Azure, Azure Landing Zones, Azure Networking, AKS, Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure Monitor, Azure Backup & Recovery, Azure Governance, Azure Cost Management.
• Microsoft 365: Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform.
• Security & Identity: Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, Zero Trust Architecture
• Endpoint Management: Microsoft Intune, Windows 11, Autopilot, Endpoint Analytics, Mobile Device Management
• Automation & DevOps: PowerShell, Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Power Automate, Microsoft Graph API

• Preferred Certifications:
• Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

• Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert

• Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert

• Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate

• Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives
