jobs.title: Control-M Batch Engineer - Consultant
jobs.description:
Mission

• Design, maintain and optimize scheduling batch workflows for production and test environment (production, uat, …) for a leading banking environment

• Ensure high availability, performance, compliance, and security of end‑to‑end processing chains supporting payments, treasury, accounting, risk, and regulatory reporting.

• Deal with different projects at the same time liaising with different technical stakeholders

• Industrialize a multi-application billing chain with prerequisites, windows, and alerting.

• Migrate job estate to Control-M Automation API + GitOps workflow.

• Maintain and update Documentation

Key Responsibilities

• Design & Industrialization
• Analyze business/IT needs and model workflows in Control-M (Jobs, Folders, Calendars, Conditions, Resources, Variables).

• Apply scheduling standards (naming, reuse, conventions).

• Automate job deployments via Control-M Application Integrator, CTM/CLI, and Automation API.

• Operations & Monitoring
• Perform daily follow-up of batches, critical jobs, SLAs, and processing windows.

• Handle production incidents (diagnosis, restart/recovery, escalation, RCA).

• Optimize runtimes, parallelism, windows, and capacity.

• Integration & DevOps
• Integrate Control-M with CI/CD (Automation API, CTM/CLI, Jenkins/GitLab CI, artifact repos).

• Package and version Control-M objects (JSON, Git).

• Document pipelines, recovery procedures, and runbooks.

• Security & Compliance
• Comply, operate and leverage the Bank’s security framework and conforming to the published security applications RACI matrix provided to all stakeholders.

• Manage access and roles (Control-M/EM, LDAP/AD).

• Apply security policies (encryption, audit, traceability).

• Contribute to audits, risk management, and continuity planning (DR/BCP).

Technical Environnent

• BMC Control-M : V9.21/9.22 Control-M/EM, Server, Agents, Workload Archiving, Automation API, CTM/CLI, Application Integrator, MFT/MFT-E

• Systems : Linux/Unix, Windows Server; z/OS knowledge a plus.

• Scripting & Languages : Shell/Bash, PowerShell, Python, SQL.

• Databases : PostgreSQL (queries, DB job scheduling).

• Middleware & Cloud : FTP/SFTP, REST/Web Services, MQ; AWS/Azure/GCP integration (Control-M for Cloud, Agents).

• CI/CD & SCM : Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI, JSON artifacts, automated testing/deployments.

• Monitoring : Integration with tools like Dynatrace, Prometheus, Splunk, Centreon.

• Security : LDAP/AD, credential management (e.g., Vault, Control-M Secrets).

Required Skills

• Mastery of Control-M scheduling (design, conditions, calendars, resources, alerting).

• Hands-on with Automation API and CTM/CLI for “jobs as code”.

• Scripting for automation and remediation.

• Understanding of batch application architectures and production constraints.

• Incident and problem management , RCA writing and corrective actions.

• Clear communication with RUN, DEV, and business teams.

Profile

• Bachelor’s/ Master’s in computer science (or equivalent experience).

• 5+ years’ experience with Control-M in production environments.

• BMC Control-M and/or ITIL certifications preferred.

• Fluent French/English required.

Soft Skills

• Rigor, service-oriented mindset, reliability in 24/7 contexts.

• Proactive, analytical, and problem-solving approach.

• Teamwork across Production, Development, and SecOps.

• Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing habits.

Work Conditions

• Possible on-call duty, and off-hours interventions based on criticality.

• Location: Geneva

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.description:
Mission
 We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Equity Analyst to join the Investment Specialist team. The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting in-depth financial analysis of publicly traded companies in specific sectors (Industrials, Aerospace & Defence), evaluating investment opportunities, building financial models, and providing actionable insights to support portfolio management and investment decisions to Wealth Management teams (DPM, Private Banking). The ideal candidate will possess strong quantitative and qualitative research skills, financial acumen, and the ability to communicate complex investment ideas clearly and persuasively. This opportunity also involves the portfolio management of two dedicated thematic equity certificates.
 Main responsibilities

• 1. Company and Industry Research
• Conduct thorough fundamental research on assigned companies and sectors across US and Europe.
• Analyze business models, industry dynamics, competitive positioning, and management quality.
• Maintain ongoing coverage of ~40-50 companies (Buy, Hold, Sell ratings), updating investment theses and valuations as new data becomes available.
• Build and maintain financial models forecasting key financial metrics, evaluate capital structure and costs as well as balance sheet health.

• 2. Investment Recommendation and Reporting
• Prepare investment reports (equity factsheets, updated quarterly), internal and external presentations summarizing sector views, valuation conclusions, and single line recommendations.
• Support senior portfolio managers (DPM) in developing investment strategies and identifying high-conviction opportunities.
• Communicate investment views clearly and concisely to internal stakeholders (private bankers, investment advisors) or clients through written reports, slide decks, or verbal presentations.

• 3. Market and Portfolio Monitoring & Management
• Assist in portfolio monitoring, identifying risks or catalysts that could affect portfolio performance (DPM Equity portfolios).
• Manage dedicated thematic equity certificates, produce performance reports and maintain dedicated presentations.

• 4. Collaboration and Cross-Functional Work
• Contribute to team administrative tasks, cross-sector publications and investment meetings.
• Work closely with DPM portfolio managers to provide timely research input, participate in Equity Committee/Global Investment Committee as required.
• Respond to internal requests from private bankers/investment advisors in a timely manner

• Your Profile
• Excellent academic record with a relevant Master's degree from a top-tier university and CFA

• 5–10 years of experience covering the Industrials and Aerospace & Defence sectors, with a strong understanding of key value drivers and industry dynamics.

• Strong ability to conduct company and industry research.

• Strong analytical and financial modelling skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to present investment ideas clearly and confidently to internal stakeholders and Clients.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.

• Proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented, with the ability to work independently.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Fluent in English; French is an asset.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Missione
Stiamo cercando un Analista Equity altamente analitico e dettagliato per aderire al team Investment Specialist. Il candidato di successo sarà responsabile di condurre un'analisi finanziaria approfondita delle aziende pubbliche scambiate in settori specifici (Industrial, Aerospace & Defence), valutare le opportunità di investimento, costruire modelli finanziari, e fornire informazioni attuabili per supportare la gestione del portafoglio e le decisioni di investimento ai team di Wealth Management (DPM, Private Banking). Il candidato ideale avrà forti capacità di ricerca quantitativa e qualitativa, acume finanziario, e la capacità di comunicare idee complesse di investimento in modo chiaro e persuasivo. Questa opportunità coinvolge anche la gestione del portafoglio di due certificati tematici dedicati.
Principali responsabilità

• 1. Ricerca aziendale e industriale
• Condurre una ricerca approfondita fondamentale sulle società e settori assegnati in tutti gli Stati Uniti e in Europa.
• Analizzare modelli di business, dinamica del settore, posizionamento competitivo e qualità di gestione.
• Mantenere la copertura continua di ~40-50 aziende (Buy, Hold, Sell valutazioni), aggiornando tesi di investimento e valutazioni come nuovi dati diventano disponibili.
• Costruisci e mantieni i modelli finanziari che prevedono metriche finanziarie chiave, valuta la struttura dei capitali e i costi e la salute del bilancio.

• 2. Raccomandazione e relazione sugli investimenti
• Preparare i rapporti di investimento (le schede di fatti dell'equità, aggiornate trimestralmente), le presentazioni interne ed esterne che sintetizzano le opinioni del settore, le conclusioni di valutazione e le raccomandazioni della linea singola.
• Sostenere i dirigenti di portafoglio senior (DPM) nello sviluppo di strategie di investimento e nell'individuazione di opportunità di alta concorrenza.
• Comunicare le opinioni degli investimenti in modo chiaro e conciso alle parti interessate interne (bancari privati, consulenti di investimento) o ai clienti attraverso rapporti scritti, piattaforme di scorrimento o presentazioni verbali.

• 3. Monitoraggio e gestione del mercato e del portafoglio
• Assistere nel monitoraggio del portafoglio, identificare i rischi o i catalizzatori che potrebbero influenzare le prestazioni del portafoglio (portafogli di Equity diDPM).
• Gestire certificati tematici azionari, produrre report sulle prestazioni e mantenere presentazioni dedicate.

• 4. Collaborazione e lavoro trasversale
• Contribuire a compiti amministrativi di squadra, pubblicazioni di settore e incontri di investimento.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i gestori del portafoglio DPM per fornire un contributo tempestivo alla ricerca, partecipare al Comitato per gli investimenti equity/Global come richiesto.
• Rispondere alle richieste interne di banchieri privati/consulenti di investimento in modo tempestivo

• Il tuo profilo

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission
We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Equity Analyst to join the Investment Specialist team. The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting in-depth financial analysis of publicly traded companies in specific sectors (Industrials, Aerospace & Defence), evaluating investment opportunities, building financial models, and providing actionable insights to support portfolio management and investment decisions to Wealth Management teams (DPM, Private Banking). The ideal candidate will possess strong quantitative and qualitative research skills, financial acumen, and the ability to communicate complex investment ideas clearly and persuasively. This opportunity also involves the portfolio management of two dedicated thematic equity certificates.
Main responsibilities

• 1. Company and Industry Research
• Conduct thorough fundamental research on assigned companies and sectors across US and Europe.
• Analyze business models, industry dynamics, competitive positioning, and management quality.
• Maintain ongoing coverage of ~40-50 companies (Buy, Hold, Sell ratings), updating investment theses and valuations as new data becomes available.
• Build and maintain financial models forecasting key financial metrics, evaluate capital structure and costs as well as balance sheet health.

• 2. Investment Recommendation and Reporting
• Prepare investment reports (equity factsheets, updated quarterly), internal and external presentations summarizing sector views, valuation conclusions, and single line recommendations.
• Support senior portfolio managers (DPM) in developing investment strategies and identifying high-conviction opportunities.
• Communicate investment views clearly and concisely to internal stakeholders (private bankers, investment advisors) or clients through written reports, slide decks, or verbal presentations.

• 3. Market and Portfolio Monitoring & Management
• Assist in portfolio monitoring, identifying risks or catalysts that could affect portfolio performance (DPM Equity portfolios).
• Manage dedicated thematic equity certificates, produce performance reports and maintain dedicated presentations.

• 4. Collaboration and Cross-Functional Work
• Contribute to team administrative tasks, cross-sector publications and investment meetings.
• Work closely with DPM portfolio managers to provide timely research input, participate in Equity Committee/Global Investment Committee as required.
• Respond to internal requests from private bankers/investment advisors in a timely manner

• Your Profile
• Excellent academic record with a relevant Master's degree from a top-tier university and CFA

• 5–10 years of experience covering the Industrials and Aerospace & Defence sectors, with a strong understanding of key value drivers and industry dynamics.

• Strong ability to conduct company and industry research.

• Strong analytical and financial modelling skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to present investment ideas clearly and confidently to internal stakeholders and Clients.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.

• Proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented, with the ability to work independently.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Fluent in English; French is an asset.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Mission
Nous cherchons un analyste de fonds propres hautement analytique et axé sur les détails pour rejoindre l'équipe de spécialistes des investissements. Le candidat retenu sera chargé d'effectuer une analyse financière approfondie des entreprises cotées en bourse dans des secteurs précis (industries, aérospatiale et défense), d'évaluer les possibilités d'investissement, d'élaborer des modèles financiers et de fournir aux équipes de gestion de patrimoine (DPM, Private Banking) des conseils pratiques pour appuyer la gestion de portefeuille et les décisions d'investissement. Le candidat idéal possédera de solides compétences en recherche quantitative et qualitative, un sens financier et la capacité de communiquer clairement et avec persuasion des idées d'investissement complexes. Cette possibilité implique également la gestion de portefeuille de deux certificats thématiques d'actions.
Principales responsabilités

• 1. Recherche sur les entreprises et l'industrie
• Mener des recherches fondamentales approfondies sur les entreprises et les secteurs désignés aux États-Unis et en Europe.
• Analyser les modèles d'affaires, la dynamique de l'industrie, le positionnement concurrentiel et la qualité de gestion.
• Maintenir la couverture continue de ~40-50 entreprises (Acheter, tenir, vendre les cotes), mettre à jour les thèses et les évaluations d'investissement à mesure que de nouvelles données deviennent disponibles.
• Élaborer et maintenir des modèles financiers prévoyant des paramètres financiers clés, évaluer la structure et les coûts du capital ainsi que la santé au bilan.

• 2. Recommandation et rapports sur les investissements
• Préparer des rapports d'investissement (fiches d'information sur les fonds propres, mises à jour trimestrielles), des présentations internes et externes résumant les points de vue du secteur, les conclusions d'évaluation et les recommandations d'une seule ligne.
• Aider les cadres supérieurs du portefeuille (DPM) à élaborer des stratégies d'investissement et à déterminer les possibilités de condamnation.
• Communiquer clairement et de façon concise les opinions en matière d'investissement aux intervenants internes (banques privées, conseillers en placement) ou aux clients au moyen de rapports écrits, de diapositives ou de présentations verbales.

• 3. Surveillance et gestion des marchés et des portefeuilles
• Aider à la surveillance du portefeuille, en identifiant les risques ou les catalyseurs susceptibles d'avoir une incidence sur le rendement du portefeuille (portefeuilles DPM Equity).
• Gérer les certificats thématiques d'équité, produire des rapports de performance et maintenir des présentations spécialisées.

• 4. Collaboration et travail interfonctionnel

jobs.title: Internship - WM Data Analyst (Zurich, 6 months)
jobs.description:
Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a premier wealth management Private Bank dedicated to delivering tailored financial solutions to a diverse clientele. Data analytics is central to how we serve clients and run the business. As a WM Data Analyst Intern, you will extract, transform, and visualize data, primarily in Microsoft Power BI, to surface insights on key wealth management topics. If you value a fast-moving environment with clear decision-making, UBP is the place for you. You will develop intelligent, data-driven solutions by transforming and aggregating data into actionable visualizations for senior management. During your Internship, you will be mentored by the Head of WM Reporting & Dashboards in our Zurich office, with occasional travel to Geneva if required.

Main responsibilities:

• Extract, transform, and load data from internal systems using SQL and/or Python

• Build intuitive, well-modelled Power BI reports and dashboards using DAX and Power Query

• Deliver insight-driven analysis and commentary for management, including trend analysis and KPI tracking

• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, iterate on prototypes, and ensure dashboard adoption

• Contribute to data quality checks and documentation, and support ad-hoc data initiatives as prioritized by the team lead

Requirements:

• Currently pursuing a master’s degree or holding a bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, or a related field

• Previous experience in banking or corporate business analytics, workshops, bootcamps is advantageous

• Technical skills in SQL, Power BI, and Python, willingness and ability to learn are essential

• Fluent in English; proficiency in German or French is highly desirable

• Strong analytical and research skills, with a natural curiosity and a structured, organized approach

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with an assertive and constructive mindset

• A proactive, adaptable, and confident team player who thrives on tackling new challenges

• Self-motivated and goal-oriented, with a "Problem-Action-Results" mindset

This is a 100% on-site, 6-month Internship in Zurich with no possibility for remote work. The preferred start date is 1st of October 2026.
 Eligible applicants must not have completed their master’s degree by the start date of the Internship. Additionally, candidates must be enrolled at a university or taking a gap year between their bachelor's and master’s studies.
